optionalfeature.name: Psychic Strike
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can unleash a painful assault on the psyches of your foes. You make a ranged psionic attack with a range of 30 feet. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d4} + your Intelligence modifier in Psychic damage. This attack is {@condition Invisible|XPHB}, and requires no visible effort on your part. The creature that you target is as aware that you are the one that struck it and of your general direction, as though you attacked with a weapon. However, other creatures relying only on vision or other mundane senses can't perceive this attack.

entries.name: ➔ Invested Strike
entries: You can replace the damage die of your psychic strike with one of your psi dice. When you do, on a hit, Invest that die into your target until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: Your strike's range increases at level 5 (60 feet), 11 (90 feet), and 17 (120 feet).

optionalfeature.name: Psychokinesis
entries: You can use your spirit to directly affect the physical world. You can interact with the environment within 30 feet of you as you would with your body.

While using psychokinesis, the amount you can push, drag, or lift is equal to 10 × your psionic ability score, and you use that score in place of Strength if your interaction requires an ability check. When you move an object with this feature, you must take the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, and you can't move that object more than 30 feet. You can't attack with weapons, grapple, or move unwilling creatures using psychokinesis.

optionalfeature.name: Psychophonics
entries: You can communicate telepathically in any language that you speak. You broadcast your telepathic speech with any number of creatures you can see within 30 feet of you.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: Your telepathy's range increases at level 5 (60 feet), 11 (90 feet), and 17 (120 feet).

optionalfeature.name: Arcing Strike
entries: The damage of your psychic strike changes to Lightning, but its range is halved. On a hit, you can force one creature of your choice within 10 feet of your target to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage 1d4} Lightning damage.

entries.name: ★ Invested Strike
entries: The second creature takes additional Lightning damage equal to your psionic ability modifier.

entries.name: ○ {@i Heighten}
entries: If you Invest a spirit shard, the lightning arcs to a third creature within 10 feet of the second.

optionalfeature.name: Dissolving Strike
entries: The damage of your psychic strike changes to Necrotic. Rather than make an attack roll, you instead force your target to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, your strike hits.

entries.name: ★ Invested Strike
entries: Reduce your target's hit point maximum by the damage dealt until your die is Divested. The die remains Invested until that creature dies, until you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or until you Divest it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: ○ {@i Heighten}
entries: If you Invest a spirit shard, the Invested creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength and Dexterity saving throws until that die is Divested.

optionalfeature.name: Embrittling Strike
entries: The damage of your psychic strike changes to Cold. Creatures made of inflexible material such as glass, stone, or ice have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to the damage from this strike.

entries.name: ★ Invested Strike
entries: When the Invested creature is dealt nonmagical, nonpsionic damage, increase that damage by 1.

entries.name: ○ {@i Heighten}
entries: If you Invest a spirit shard, the Invested creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws until that die is Divested.

optionalfeature.name: Luminant Strike
entries: The damage of your psychic strike changes to Radiant, its range becomes 60 feet, and rather than make an attack roll, you instead force your target to make a Dexterity saving throw. If it fails, your strike hits. On a success, it takes 1 Radiant damage.

entries.name: ★ Invested Strike
entries: An Invested creature glows and becomes brightly lit while that die Invests it. This light is visible through both magical and psionic darkness.

entries.name: ○ {@i Heighten}
entries: If you Invest a spirit shard, you may Exhaust that die when your target fails its save. If you do, that creature is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until that die is Divested.

optionalfeature.name: Phonic Strike
entries: The damage of your psychic strike changes to Thunder. Until the beginning of your next turn, your target loses {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on any ability checks that require hearing. Creatures within 30 feet of your target can hear this strike telepathically, though it makes no audible sound.

entries.name: ★ Invested Strike
entries: Your target's mind rings with a nauseating, dizzying tone. When it makes a damage roll while Invested, it rolls twice as many dice, then keeps a number of the lowest results equal to the number of dice for the original roll.

entries.name: ○ {@i Heighten}
entries: If you Invest a spirit shard, that creature can't emit telepathic communication or receive it from creatures other than you while so Invested.

optionalfeature.name: Shielding Strike
entries: Rather than make an attack, you grant a creature in range {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your strike's damage die.

entries.name: ★ Invested Strike
entries: Your target gains additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your psionic ability modifier.

entries.name: ○ {@i Heighten}
entries: You also gain those {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Adamant Shard
entries: You gain one bonus rank 6 spirit shard, a {@dice d20}.
If Invested, Divest it at the end of your next turn. When rolled for damage, Tap it. When you Tap it for any other reason, and when it is Divested, Exhaust it.

optionalfeature.name: Bolstered Psychokinesis
entries: Through practice and application, you have strengthened your telekinesis, allowing you to affect larger objects and unwilling creatures. The amount you can push, drag, and lift when using your telekinesis is doubled, as is your interaction range.

Additionally, as a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can attempt to {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Grapple} a Medium or smaller creature using psychokinesis. Use your psionic save DC as your grappling DC, and your psychokinesis range as your grappling range. You can move a creature grappled this way, though every foot you move it costs 1 extra foot of your psychokinetic movement.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: You can grapple larger targets as your APL increases: Large or smaller at 5+, Huge or smaller at 11+, and Gargantuan or smaller at 20+.

optionalfeature.name: Bolstered Psychophonics
entries: Your dedication has expanded the bounds of your telepathic power. As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you may form a telepathic connection with a willing creature within range of your psychophonics feature. You can form a number of these connections equal to twice your psionic ability modifier, minimum of 1.
Creatures connected this way can communicate telepathically with one another in languages that they know, with a range equal to your psychophonics feature.
This connection lapses if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If you attempt to form a connection when already at your maximum number, a connection of your choice lapses.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: If your APL is 11+, creatures can use the telepathy granted by this feature in place of the verbal requirements of features such as spells, and the range of those features becomes equal to the range of that telepathy when targeting connected creatures.

optionalfeature.name: Brutal Psionics
entries: The {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} range for your psychic strike and for psionic talents for which you make an attack roll is expanded by 1. Whenever a creature rolls a 1 on a saving throw against your psychic strike or one of your talents, your ability scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Forceful Psionics
entries: When you damage a creature with your psychic strike or with one of your psionic talents, you may force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, move it up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: At APL 11+, you can move that creature in any direction.

optionalfeature.name: Harmonic Echo
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature Invested with one or more of your psi dice takes damage, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, deal it Psychic damage equal to the roll of any number of those dice, then Divest those dice.

entries.name: {@i Heighten}
entries: If you Divest at least one spirit shard, you can change the damage to a type of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Harmonic Pulse
entries: Whenever a creature Invested with your psi dice regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you can roll any number of the Invested dice to increase the amount gained or regained by the result. Then Divest any dice rolled this way that weren't Invested by an Investiture talent.

optionalfeature.name: Horizon Strike
entries: Double the range of your psychic strike.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: At APL 11+, triple it. Quadruple it at 17+.

optionalfeature.name: Immortal Knowing
entries: Your {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} range expands to 20 feet. Within that range, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks using the {@skill Perception|XPHB} or {@skill Insight|XPHB} skill, and creatures within that radius don't benefit from {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half or Three Quarters Cover} against you.

optionalfeature.name: Insidious Psionics
entries: When you damage a creature using a psionic feature, such as a talent or psychic strike, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it forgets that you were the source of that damage. On a success, it is {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to this effect for 24 hours.

optionalfeature.name: Instill Doubt
entries: When a creature that you can see within range of your psychic strike misses with an attack or fails a saving throw, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a psychic strike against that creature. If you damage it this way, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Metamorphosis
entries: Your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} is reduced by half when you apply it to Wisdom saving throws. You gain proficiency in a saving throw of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Mortal Knowing
entries: You have honed your ability to perceive the world around you using not your body, but your spirit.
You can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} — both magical and nonmagical — within 60 feet of yourself. Psionic darkness can still block your vision.
Additionally, you have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Opportunistic Strike
entries: You can make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} with your psychic strike as though it were a weapon with a reach of 5 or 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Physicality
entries: Your personal discoveries have resulted in the realization that a mind develops best when supported by a capable body.

You gain proficiency with one ranged and one melee Martial weapon of your choice, as well as training with {@filter Medium armor and Shields|items|type=!treasure (gemstone);!treasure (art object);shield;!futuristic;medium armor;!renaissance;!treasure (coinage);!modern;!trade bar}. Additionally, if you don't have proficiency in Constitution saving throws, you gain a bonus to those saving throws equal to half of your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, rounded down.
You can replace the weapon proficiencies chosen this way with different weapons whenever you gain a level in this class.

optionalfeature.name: Psionic Impulse
entries: Your psionic power has become so interwoven with your body that you no longer need to walk. Instead, you can levitate just above any surface. While hovering, you can move freely along any vertical or horizontal surface, ignoring any slippery or sticky effects upon that surface and any effects of {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} that doesn't extend away from the surface. You are still slowed by particularly jagged terrain, by obstacles such as furniture, and by reaching or grasping vines or similar effects. Additionally, you gain the following benefits:

items: You take half damage from falling.
When jumping, you may use your Intelligence score rather than your Strength score.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can grant yourself a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Psychodiscorporation
entries: You have developed the ability to store solid objects in the space between reality and your imagination.

You can spend 1 minute storing a nonliving object in this space, which only you can access. Once you have stored an object, you can retrieve it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. It appears in your hand or in a space adjacent to you. If an object has been retrieved from your storage within the past 8 hours, you can also store it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

Time does not pass for objects you have stored this way. You can store up to 100 pounds of objects this way, but you can't store an object if its weight exceeds your weight limit for your psychokinesis.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: At APL 5+, you can store up to 200 pounds. This increases at 11+ (400 pounds) and 17+ (800 pounds).

optionalfeature.name: Push/Pull
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, or in place of one psychic strike made when you take a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} to activate your psychic strike, you can move each creature and/or object Invested with one of your psi dice, either pushing a creature straight away from you by 10 feet, pulling it toward you by 10 feet, or moving yourself in any direction.

optionalfeature.name: Pyrokinesis Ⅰ
entries: When you deal damage with a talent or other psionic feature, such as your psychic strike, you can change the damage type to Fire. When you do, your psychic strike and talents that would normally be invisible are visible.
At the beginning of a creature's turn, you can deal that creature 1 Fire damage for each of your psi dice Invested into it.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: The burn damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach APL 5 (2), 11 (3), and 17 (4).

optionalfeature.name: Pyrokinesis Ⅱ
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can ignite either a creature Invested with at least one of your psi dice or a flammable object you are moving with your psychokinesis feature. The target takes Fire damage equal to {@damage 1d6} + your psionic ability modifier + 1 for each Invested psi die. Each other creature within 5 feet when that object or creature ignites must make a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} + your psionic ability modifier in Fire damage.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: The ignition damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d6}), 11 ({@damage 3d6}), and 17 ({@damage 4d6}).

optionalfeature.name: Reality Adjustment
entries: When you or a creature within 30 feet rolls a die, before you know the result, you can Tap one of your psi dice, roll it, and add the result to that roll.

entries.name: {@i Heighten}
entries: If you spend a spirit shard, also add your psionic ability modifier.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: At APL 11+, you may instead Exhaust the die to subtract from the roll, rather than add to it.

optionalfeature.name: Solace
entries: You don't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} from creatures Invested with your psi dice.

optionalfeature.name: Whispers of the Night
entries: Whenever you Exhaust a die as part of the cost to activate a cryptogogy talent, you can give yourself the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Zone of Aid
entries: You subtly cultivate your surroundings to favor your allies, granting the following benefits to creatures of your choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that originates from you.

items: Every two feet of movement within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} costs 1 less foot of {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} for you and your allies.

Whenever another creature within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you can increase the amount gained by your Intelligence modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Zone of Ire
entries: You project a constant hindrance for creatures toward which you are {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile}, inflicting the following hindrances on your enemies within a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that originates from you.

items: Each foot of movement within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} costs them 1 extra foot of Speed.
All damage they take deals an extra 1 Psychic damage.

default: (a) {@item leather armor|XPHB}, 2 {@item dagger|XPHB}s, 1 {@item book|XPHB} (nonfiction), a {@item scholar's pack|XPHB}, and 1 GP OR (b) 80 GP

entries: {@b Aggregate Psionics.} When determining your aggregate psionicist level, multiply your Psion levels by 1.

classFluff.name: Psion

entries: Impassive, a human noblewoman sips at her glass of wine, eyes intent upon the would-be suitor to her side. Shouts of alarm erupt when, at the head of the table her rival collapses, dead, with no hint of pain or injury. The noblewoman only smirks.

A graying dwarf hovers upon a crumbling cliffside, her feet unworried by the sharp stones. Though the wind whips through her beard, she remains still even as her mind drags her foe from its purchase, sending it plummeting downward.

Guarded by a stoic othryn, a halfling pads silently along the corridor of an abandoned mine. He makes no sound, but he connects his party nonetheless, relaying information from scout to scout and back, so that they all remain informed.

Psions are dedicated, practiced users of mental energy. Though the extent to which a psion's powers are inherent or trained varies from individual, the truth is universally a blend of innate power combined with rigorous study, constant experimentation, and an eternal process of discovery.

The most adept users of psionic talents, psions gain three of the five psionic foundations and can thus access the broadest range of psionic talents. They also have the deepest well of mental energy from which to draw, allowing them to make the most of their wide array of capabilities. Their intensive study and psionic praxis also leads psions to make Discoveries, psionic revelations that alter not only their powers, but the ways they interact with the world.

Psions are often stereotyped as insular, silent, and unfriendly, but as with all broad generalizations, these labels aren't good indicators of an individual's tendencies. While many psions struggle to remain connected to the physical world as their spirit grows in strength and influence, an equal number find joy in remaining connected to it.

As psionic practitioners dedicated to the regimented study of their art, it is rare — but not impossible — for a psion to be purely self-taught. Many psions make their first Discoveries within conclaves or under the tutelage of a master before setting out into the world to seek paths of their own.

classFeature.name: Psionic Power
entries: You have developed the capacity to influence the world — and other beings within it — with your mind.

entries.name: Psionic Foundations
entries: You gain the {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI} foundation and your choice of either the {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI} or {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI} foundation.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: You gain the unchosen foundation at Psion level 5.

entries.name: Talents Known
entries: You know talents of your choice, and you learn more as you gain Psion levels, as shown in the Talents Known column of the Psion Features table. When you gain a level in Psion, you can replace one talent you know with another for which you meet the prerequisites.

entries.name: Refined Numena
entries: The Psion Features table shows how many Psi Dice you possess of rank 1+.

entries.name: Psionic Ability Modifier
entries: Intelligence is your psionic ability for your Psion talents and other psionic capabilities.

classFeature.name: Extra Strike
entries: You can attack twice, rather than once, when you use a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} to attack with {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}. However, you can't add your ability modifier to the damage of the additional attacks.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: At Psion level 5+, you can attack thrice.

classFeature.name: Discoveries
entries: You have cultivated and strengthened your spirit so thoroughly that you have begun to alter its natural function. You make two Discoveries: insights into the nature and function of your power that alter your interaction with both it and the world.

You gain access to additional Discoveries as you gain Psion levels, as shown in the Discoveries Known column of the Psion Features table. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one Discovery you know with another for which you meet the prerequisites.

classFeature.name: Spirit Shards
entries: Through continual practice, you have managed to refine a portion of your psionic power into something greater.
You gain two spirit shards. Their number increases as you gain Psion levels, as shown on the Psion Features table, and their rank is equal to that of your psi dice.

classFeature.name: Path of Power
entries: You have turned your gaze inward and beheld the vectors by which you must travel in order push your spiritual growth to its limits. You take the first step along a Path of Power, gaining its specialized features.

At Psion levels 7, 10, 14, and 18, you can either advance one step along your current Path, or take your first step along a new one. If a Path has one or more prerequisites, you must meet them only if you've taken one or more steps in a different Path.

classFeature.name: Feat
entries: You gain a {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Psion levels 8, 12, 16, and 19. At character level 19, that feat can be an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB}.

classFeature.name: Parallel Processing
entries: When you take the {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} to attack with your {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can activate a talent with an activation time of 1 Action or 1 Bonus Action in place of one of your psychic strikes.

Additionally, you can activate raw talents you don't know as though you knew them. You can do so a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1), and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Signature Strike
entries: You have developed even your most basic of psionic capacities to a new level. You learn one of the shifts below. When you use your psychic strike, you can employ one shift to alter its effects.
You learn a second shift when you reach Psion level 15.

items: {@optfeature Arcing Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}
{@optfeature Dissolving Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}
{@optfeature Embrittling Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}
{@optfeature Luminant Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}
{@optfeature Phonic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}
{@optfeature Shielding Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}

classFeature.name: Path of Power

classFeature.name: Feat
entries: You gain a {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Psion levels 8, 12, 16, and 19. At character level 19, that feat can be an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB}.

classFeature.name: Iron Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to prevent the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

classFeature.name: Path of Power
entries: At Psion levels 7, 10, 14, and 18, you can either advance one step along your current Path, or take your first step along a new one. If a Path has one or more prerequisites, you must meet them only if you've taken one or more steps in a different Path.

classFeature.name: Flux Growth
entries: You gain a second set of bonus spirit shards of a lower rank, as shown in the Bonus Shards column of the Psion Features table.

classFeature.name: Feat
entries: You gain a {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Psion levels 8, 12, 16, and 19. At character level 19, that feat can be an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB}.

classFeature.name: Mind Over Body
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. You can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Path of Power
entries: At Psion levels 7, 10, 14, and 18, you can either advance one step along your current Path, or take your first step along a new one. If a Path has one or more prerequisites, you must meet them only if you've taken one or more steps in a different Path.

classFeature.name: Second Shift
entries: You learn a second shift for your Signature Strike feature.

classFeature.name: Feat
entries: You gain a {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Psion levels 8, 12, 16, and 19. At character level 19, that feat can be an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB}.

classFeature.name: Effluxion
entries: Whenever you Exhaust a non-temporary spirit shard of Rank 4+, you can create a temporary Rank 1 spirit shard. It ceases to exist when you Tap, Exhaust, or Divest it, when you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Path of Power
entries: At Psion levels 7, 10, 14, and 18, you can either advance one step along your current Path, or take your first step along a new one. If a Path has one or more prerequisites, you must meet them only if you've taken one or more steps in a different Path.

classFeature.name: Feat
entries: You gain a {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Psion levels 8, 12, 16, and 19. At character level 19, that feat can be an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB}.

classFeature.name: Sojourn
entries: You take one step along any Path of Power, then take another step either along that Path or another of your choice. If either step you choose is the first step, you don't have to meet its prerequisites in order to take it with this feature.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Clarity
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Wisdom 13+

You have shaped a portion of your psionic energy into a second, lesser mind that operates alongside your true mind. This mind doesn't think or dream, but it excels at absorbing and memorizing information.

subclassFeature.name: Psionic Codex
entries: Your awakening has caused the formation of a second pseudo-mind, called a codex, that exists alongside your own. It has an amazing memory, storing things you have witnessed, even in passing, throughout the whole of its existence. It grants you the following capabilities.

entries.name: Supreme Recollection
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks made to recall information.

entries.name: Impeccable Storage
entries: The codex stores your last 24 hours of experiences as pristine, accessible memories. For as long as these memories are stored, you can't forget them. You can add selections from these memories to an inviolable cache, which can hold up to 8 hours of memories.

entries.name: Installed Capacity
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you may choose to have the codex either grant you one proficiency from the list below, or maintain your current proficiency. When using that proficiency during a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can use your Intelligence modifier for that test, rather than any other skill modifier. If that test is an attack roll, you can also use Intelligence, rather than another ability, for the attack and damage rolls.
One gaming set, skill, tool, or vehicle
One weapon type (such as longswords or handaxes)
Armor of one weight higher than that in which you are already trained
Shields

subclassFeature.name: Extraspiritual Study
entries: You gain one {@filter Psionic Foundation|optionalfeatures|feature type=psionic foundations}, one {@filter Discovery|optionalfeatures|feature type=discoveries}, one {@filter Fighting Style|feats|category=fs} feat, or one {@filter Eldritch Invocation|optionalfeatures|feature type=ei} for which you meet the prerequisites. If your choice references one of your ability scores, replace it with Intelligence. You can change your selection whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

Additionally, when you choose from the list for installed capacity, you can either choose two options, gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with a choice from option 1, or unlock the mastery properties of a choice from option 2.

subclassFeature.name: Shared Codex
entries: You can share the guidance of your codex with your allies. As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature within range of your psychophonics feature makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} with which you are proficient, you can grant that creature a bonus to the test equal to half of your proficiency bonus, rounded up.

subclassFeature.name: Manifested Assistant
entries: Your codex has grown in strength and form. It remains awake even while you sleep and constantly minds your surroundings. You can't be surprised, and you make Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks while {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} as though you were conscious.
Additionally, when you take a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can will your codex do one of the following:

items: It makes a ranged psionic attack against a target of your choice within 30 feet. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d4} + your Intelligence modifier in Psychic damage.
It grants {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d4} + your Intelligence modifier to a creature you can see within 30 feet.

entries: When it does, it becomes briefly visible, taking a form of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Perfected Codex
entries: Your codex's functionality has been refined to perfection, improving several of its capacities.

items.name: Installed Capacity
entries: You can now select three options. Options 3 & 4 count as one selection.

items.name: Manifested Assistant
entries: You can choose both modes, rather than just one.

items.name: Extraspiritual Study
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can gain a second selection from those available, and you can change one or both selections when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Denial
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Charisma 13+
You have targeted your psionic growth at the ability to affect the outcomes of situations, denying or remaking those which displease you.

subclassFeature.name: Cultivated Detachment
entries: The physical world is, in your estimation, lesser than the spiritual. The firmness of this belief grants you two benefits.

entries.name: Armor of Denial
entries: You constantly project a denial of events that affect you negatively. You add your Intelligence modifier to your AC. You don't gain this benefit while concentrating, while you have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition(s), or while wearing armor in which you lack training.

entries.name: Rejection
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you or a creature you can see within range of your psychic strike succeeds or fails on a saving throw, you can force that creature to reroll, possibly changing the result. If you change the result, you can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Threads of Nullification
entries: You can attempt to forestall events that don't benefit you with a mere twist of your will.

As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature within range of your psychic strike takes an {@action Attack|XPHB}, {@action Magic|XPHB}, or {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can attempt to deny that action. Your target makes a Charisma saving throw. If it fails, its action is prevented, any resources it spent are lost, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. If it succeeds, you unTap one of your Tapped psi dice.

subclassFeature.name: Rule of the Void
entries: You can take an additional {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} each round.
Whenever you take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can attack once with your psychic strike as part of that {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Unyielding Self
entries: You are immune to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid being inflicted with all other conditions.

subclassFeature.name: Erase
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature within range of your psychic strike takes damage or fails a saving throw, you can make one psychic strike against that creature. If you damage the creature with that strike, its connection to reality becomes tenuous.

At the end of this turn, if that creature has less than 10% of its total {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, your target is erased. Its body, soul, and spirit cease to exist, and memories of it are wiped from all minds but yours and those of deities. Any impact it had in life remains, as do any written or otherwise recorded records of it, but those who have forgotten the creature can't connect those reminders with that creature.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Destruction
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} {@optfeature Horizon Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI}
Eschewing more complex methodology, you have focused your development upon the destructive power of your psychic strike.

subclassFeature.name: Striker
entries: The base damage of your un-Invested psychic strike becomes {@damage 1d6}. When you activate it, you can change its damage type to Force.

subclassFeature.name: Divide
entries: When you activate your psychic strike, rather than target one creature, you can target each creature of your choice in a 1-foot-wide line with a length equal to your psychic strike's range. If you Invested your strike, you can Invest each creature damaged by it with one of your unspent psi dice.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Strike Zone
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you create a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range of your psychic strike. The area within that {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for your enemies. You can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to target a creature that moves within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} with your psychic strike. The first time you do so each round, it doesn't use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.
Your strike zone lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} or gain the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once). You regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Impact Zone
entries: When you create your strike zone, each creature of your choice within it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes {@damage 3d8} + your psionic ability modifier in Force damage, or half as much on a success.

subclassFeature.name: Conquer
entries: When you alter your psychic strike with Divide, as you draw the line, you can bend it up to 90° a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier. It can't cross back over itself.

subclassFeature.name: Worldscar
entries: Once per turn when you make a psychic strike, you can leave behind a wound in the world's numena. The wound is a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} either between you and your target or along the path drawn by Divide. A creature that touches the wound for the first time each turn or ends its turn touching the wound makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Development
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Either 1) {@optfeature Bolstered Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI} or 2) {@optfeature Bolstered Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI}
While some psions turn their minds toward developing novel capacities, your focus is on improving those you already possess, heightening them to a new level of perfection.

subclassFeature.name: Spiritual Empowerment
entries: You have perfected your psychophonics and psychokinesis features beyond what other practitioners normally bother to achieve. You gain the following improvements to those foundations, even if you gain them later.

entries.name: Psychophonics
entries: You can replace any requirements to speak aloud with your psychophonic communication. When you communicate telepathically, creatures can understand you regardless of whether you share a language.

entries.name: Psychokinesis
entries: When you use your psychokinesis to take the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can do so as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move an object up to 60 feet, and you can make one improvised weapon attack with an object you move this way, using your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage roles. When you release an object, you can cause it to float in place until the end of your next turn, rather than falling immediately.

subclassFeature.name: Redoubled Effort
entries: When you miss with an attack made as part of a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, or when a creature succeeds against a saving throw you force as part of that action, you can take an additional {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} this turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Empowered Psyche
entries: Your grasp of your psychophonics and psychokinesis features further improves.

entries.name: Psychophonics
entries: If you have communicated with a creature telepathically within the last 8 hours, you can ignore your range limit when communicating with that creature with that feature. This doesn't affect the range of talents or other features that rely on your psychophonics feature for their range.

entries.name: Psychokinesis
entries: You can target up to two objects, rather than just one, when using your psychokinesis to take the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. If you do so as an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can make an attack with one or both objects.

subclassFeature.name: Mirrormind
entries: When you resist Psychic damage, the creature that damaged you takes Psychic damage equal to the damage you resisted. This reflected damage isn't affected by {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}.

When a creature inflicts you with the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, it makes a Wisdom saving throw against your psionic save DC. If it fails, it gains that condition.

entries.name: Master Telepath
entries: You gain mindsense with a range equal to your psychophonics feature. Your mindsense replaces sight as a requirement for your psychophonics feature and for any of your talents that use it to define their range.

entries.name: Master Telekinetic
entries: The weight limit for your psychokinesis feature is doubled, and when using it for attacks with objects, you may use one of your unspent psi dice as the damage die.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Fire
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} {@optfeature Pyrokinesis Ⅰ|QuetsPsionicVolI}

entries.name: Aspectual Alignment
entries: You are aligned to the Fire aspect.

entries.name: Master of the Flames
entries: Whenever you deal Fire damage, you can Tap one of your psi dice to add it to your damage roll. You can also take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when another creature within 15 feet of you deals Fire damage to Tap a psi die, roll it, and either increase or decrease that Fire damage by the result.

entries.name: Lambent Numena
entries: Once per turn when you take the {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} to attack with your psychic strike, you can emit flames either in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} or a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on you. Each creature in the area of effect makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes {@damage 1d6} Fire damage.

entries.name: ➔ Invested Flames
entries: You can Invest a psi die into yourself to use it in place of the {@dice d6} when determining this action's damage. That die Divests at the beginning of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Braid of Fire
entries: When you Tap or Exhaust a spirit shard, you create a flame shard, which is a die of equal Rank. You lose a flame shard when you spend it or after 1 minute has passed since you gained it.
You can spend flame shards as though they were psi dice for Thoughts Aflame and for Investing your psychic strike. You can't apply a shift to a strike Invested this way.

subclassFeature.name: Induction
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to mundane Fire damage and {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all other Fire damage.

When you resist Fire damage, create a Rank 3 ({@dice d8}) flame shard. Once you've created a number of flame shards this way equal to your psionic ability modifier, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Reignition
entries: When you use Mind Over Body, you create a number of Rank 3 ({@dice d8}) flame shards equal to your psionic ability modifier. Roll them. Each creature of your choice within range of your psychic strike takes Fire damage equal to the result.

subclassFeature.name: Pyrofacture
entries: Flame shards and temporary spirit shards you create of Rank 3 or less are Rank 4 ({@dice d10}) instead.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Obscurity
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Dexterity 13+

subclassFeature.name: Muted Presence
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of {@skill Stealth|XPHB}, {@skill Deception|XPHB}, or {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}.
When making an ability check using {@skill Stealth|XPHB}, {@skill Deception|XPHB}, or {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, you can make that check using Intelligence, rather than any other ability score.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can use the {@action Influence|XPHB} action on a creature you can see within 10 feet or within range of your psychophonics, whichever is further. The DC is equal to your target's Wisdom score. If you succeed, the next attack you make against that creature this turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Cruel Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with your psychic strike, you can roll one of the damage dice an additional time and deal extra damage equal to the result. You can do so only if you had {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll, or if your target had {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against your strike.

entries.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: You can roll the die once more when you reach Obscurity steps Ⅲ (2×) and Ⅴ (3×).

subclassFeature.name: The Void's Embrace
entries: You have learned to cloak yourself in the dark shadows of your own mind, using your psionic powers to avoid detection. You can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

When you take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action, you can grant yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the roll and dampen your presence for one hour. While dampened this way, you leave no mark of your passage, rendering tracking you by mundane means impossible, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all {@skill Stealth|XPHB} checks

While this effect is active, a creature using magic in an attempt to locate you or an object you're carrying has a chance to fail. If a spell, psionic effect, or other supernatural ability would reveal your location or show your image to a creature, that creature makes an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check against your psionic save DC. If it fails, your image or location is not revealed by that effect.
Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can do so again.

subclassFeature.name: Oneiric Strike
entries: When you damage a creature with your psychic strike, if your target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, you can make an additional psychic strike against that creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Shadowsoul
entries: You have learned to briefly suppress the pressure most beings exert on reality, causing you to slip out of all perception — including your own. Once during each of your turns, you can forgo any amount of movement to teleport to a point you can see within that distance.

As you do, you can take a step further outside of reality. For one sliver of a moment, you become perfectly aware of the architecture of the world around you. During this moment, you can effectively see in all directions at once, ignoring any mundane, magical, or psionic barriers to your sight. You can teleport twice the distance of the speed you forwent. Once you step further in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Psionic Cascade
entries: When you roll a 1 on a damage die when dealing Psychic damage, roll that die again. You deal extra Psychic damage equal to the result. If you roll a 1 again, your target gains the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions until the end of your next turn.

psionic.name: Astral Barrage
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You forge your psionic power into a constellation of {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} star-like motes of energy. Make a ranged psionic attack against one creature you can see within range. On a hit, your target takes 1 Radiant damage for each mote.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: On a miss, you recall the motes, which hover around you until the end of your next turn. During that turn, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attack with the motes again. Hit or miss, the motes vanish.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you create {@dice 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} motes instead.

psionic.name: Beacon of Disparity
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 Round {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}/ ✦ 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

With a twist of your will, you manifest a disorienting beacon of coruscating psionic energy above and behind your head, which disperses at the end of your next turn. It radiates an aura in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.
Your enemies perceive the area within the aura as {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.

Your allies perceive the area within the aura as {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB|Brightly Lit} and unobscured by the effects of visual hindrances such as darkness, fog, or smoke, though this has no effect on solid hindrances such as foliage or a barrier.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the beacon instead lasts for ✦ 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}.

psionic.name: Blank
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 60 ft.
{@b Target:} 1 (✦or more) creatures
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 round

A creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you are imperceptible to it until the end of your next turn, and it is unaware you attempted to avoid its notice. During that time, it temporarily forgets about your existence.
On a successful save, your target is aware of your attempt, though not precisely of you or your exact location.

entries.name: Improvement
items: Your number of targets increases by one when you reach levels 5 (two), 11 (four), and 17 (eight).

psionic.name: Center
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous → which you take at the beginning of a round of initiative
You gain {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. This round, your turn takes place on initiative count 0.
This round, you can do two of the following:

items: When you fail a saving throw, you can add {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} to that roll, possibly changing the result.
When you miss with an attack, you can add {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} to the roll, possibly changing the result.
When you deal damage, you can deal {@damge d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} extra damage.
Once when you take damage, you can reduce that damage by {@damge d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.

entries: You can choose each option only once.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you can use three options, and you can choose the same option more than once.

psionic.name: Decompress
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 10 feet
{@b Target:} Sphere
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You compress raw numena into a tiny bead, then allow it to burst outward. Each creature within 5 feet of a point you can see within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} Thunder damage on a failure or {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} on a success.
{@i Heighten} — If no creatures fail the Dexterity saving throw, the Exhausted die becomes unspent.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychotelechy
entries: If you have the Psychotelechy foundation, unlock the following effects.

items: Once per turn, you can activate this talent when you hit a creature with a psiblade, no action required. When you do, you can form the Sphere centered on any point within 5 feet of that creature.

psionic.name: Deny
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous → which you take when you are hit by a ranged spell or psionic attack
You reimagine the energy pathways between you and your attacker. You add a +3 bonus to your AC for the triggering attack, possibly turning the hit into a miss.

psionic.name: Detect Psionics
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 minute
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —/✦⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)} For the duration, you sense the presence of psionic effects, items, and abilities within 30 feet of you.
{@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Cost:} ✦⇓ (Tap 1)

Expand your detection radius to 60 feet until the end of your turn. Each creature within range makes an Intelligence saving throw. You become aware of the number of creatures with psionic abilities that fail, though you can't pinpoint which creatures or their locations.
{@i Heighten} — You can precisely pinpoint creatures and their locations if you tapped a spirit shard this way, allowing you to perceive them as accurately as you would with sight.

psionic.name: Dyspraxic Wave
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round
A warping wave of psionic energy roils out from you, interrupting the motor functions of each creature caught in its path.
Each hostile creature in a 20-foot Cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have Disadvantage on all D20 Tests using Dexterity until the end of your next turn.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this ability, each affected creature takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage. Creatures that fail take additional Psychic damage equal to your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Exert
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
✦ You can Exhaust a Tapped die to pay the cost of this talent.

You overdraw a portion of your power to make a ranged psionic attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, your target takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier in Psychic damage. You take Psychic {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} equal to the result of the lowest roll.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, it deals {@damage 3d4;3d6;3d8;3d10;3d12|3[✧]} Psychic damage instead. At the beginning of your next turn, alleviate any {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} dealt to you by this talent.

psionic.name: Force Needle
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 60 ft.
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
Choose a creature you can see within range. Your target takes Force damage equal to {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier. This damage can't be resisted or reduced.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, the Force damage becomes {@damage 4d4;4d6;4d8;4d10;4d12|4[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Inversion
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous → which you take when you are dealt non-Psychic damage
You change the triggering damage to Psychic {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychophonics
entries: If you have the Psychophonics foundation, unlock the following effects.

entries.name: Furtherance: Tap 1
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} during your next turn, you can alleviate up to {@dice 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}. If you alleviate at least 1 {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} the way, you can force a creature within range of your psychophonics to make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, it takes Psychic damage equal to the amount of {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} alleviated, and it can't make attacks during its next turn.

psionic.name: Mind Thrust
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⇓⇓ (Tap 2)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You unleash a powerful burst of psionic energy at a target's mind. Make a ranged psionic attack against one creature you can perceive within range. On a hit, your target takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Psychic damage and has the Stunned condition until the beginning of your next turn.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard, that creature takes additional damage equal to your psionic ability modifier. Additionally, ✦ on a miss, one of those dice of your choice remains unspent.

psionic.name: Psychometabolism
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 day

You redirect your psionic energies to convince your body to ignore its needs. You regain {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. For one day, you ignore your body's need for nourishment.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, you regain additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Realign
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓/✦⟱⟱ (Tap/✦Exhaust 2)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You gain {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and lose your choice of the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend two spirit shards, you can activate this talent despite the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition, and you add {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} to the list of conditions you can choose to end.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychoformation
entries: If you have the Psychoformation foundation, unlock the following effects.

✦ You may Exhaust the spent dice, rather than Tap them. If you do, you regain {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in addition to this talent's other effects.

psionic.name: Resonate
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action/✦✦ Bonus Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} Another Creature
{@b Cost:} —/✦ ⥥ (Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}/✦1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
Until the end of your next turn, another creature you can see within range gets a +1 bonus to magic and psionic damage.

✦ You can Invest your target with a psi die as you activate this talent. If you do, instead of a +1 bonus, it rolls that die and deals extra damage equal to the result each time it deals magic or psionic damage.

{@i Heighten} — ✦✦ You can spend a spirit shard to activate this talent as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Additionally, once per turn when the Invested creature rolls that die, it can reroll it. It must use the new result.

psionic.name: Sapping Grasp
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

A creature you can perceive within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage, then gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until the end of this turn. It awakens immediately if it takes any further damage.
✦If your target succeeds, your die remains unspent.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, your target takes additional damage equal to your psionic ability modifier, and the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until the end of that creature's next turn unless interrupted.

psionic.name: Sever Impulse
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱⥥ (Exhaust + Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

A creature you can perceive within range makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage and and you Invest it with the Exhausted die for the duration, flooding it with disruptive signals.

While Invested, the affected creature's {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} (if any) is reduced to 0. All of its other {@variantrule Speed|XPHB|Speeds} are reduced by half, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 5. At the end of each of its turns, that creature can repeat the Intelligence saving throw, ending this talent on a success.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, for the duration, your target can't add its Strength or Dexterity modifier to its attack rolls.

psionic.name: Synaptic Burst
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self (20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation})
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You emit a jittering burst of psionic energy in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature within makes an Intelligence saving throw. Roll the tapped die. If the result is 4 or higher, roll it once more, or twice more instead if the result is 8 or higher. Combine your results. On a failure, a creature takes Psychic damage equal to the total.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, your second roll (but no others) may also cause additional rolls.

psionic.name: Synesthesiac Wave
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self (20-foot Cone)
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round
A wave of scintillating light and confusing sensation ripples forth from you, jumbling the senses of each creature caught in its path.

Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Charisma saving throw. Each creature that fails has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} using Wisdom until the end of your next turn.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, each creature that fails takes Radiant damage equal to {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Triplicity
entries: {@b Activation Time:} ✦ Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓⟱ (Tap 2 + Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You make three ranged psionic attacks against a single creature you can see within range. Each attack deals [✧✧✧] Psychic damage.
The second time this talent hits, the target gains the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute.
The third time this talent hits, the target gains {@condition Brittle|QuetsPsionicVolI|Brittle [✧✧✧]} until it no longer has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychokinesis
entries: If you have the Psychokinesis foundation, unlock the following effects.
Each time you hit the target, you can push it 10 feet away or pull it 10 feet toward you.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard, you can instead move the target in any direction.

psionic.name: Warp
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You briefly absorb your body into your spirit, then teleport to an unoccupied space.

You determine whether you could reach that space as though you had a flying speed of 30 feet. While teleporting, you can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, and you can take Psionic actions. You can also communicate telepathically while teleporting.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you can teleport twice as far.

psionic.name: Wayfind
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You briefly tap into the world consciousness to orient yourself within its sphere. You become aware of the following:

items: Which way is north, or its equivalent on your current plane
Which way is up, or its equivalent on your current plane
The direction of a location familiar to you, in which you have spent at least an hour within the past 30 days

psionic.name: Aura Slap
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action | ✦ Trigger
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You collect a whirling bundle of doubts in your open palm. Make a melee psionic attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, it takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} Psychic damage and gains {@condition Brittle|QuetsPsionicVolI|Brittle [✧]} until the beginning of your next turn.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, your target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until it loses the {@condition Brittle|QuetsPsionicVolI} condition.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychotelechy
entries: If you have the Psychotelechy foundation, unlock the following effects.
✦ Once per turn, you can activate this talent targeting a creature when you hit that creature with a psiblade, no action required.

psionic.name: Beacon of Instigation
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round
You emit an infuriating peal of psychosonority in an {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of a range equal to your psychophonics.

When an enemy begins its turn within the aura, if it can see you, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it moves as close to you as possible, then it makes one melee weapon attack against you if able. It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against other creatures this turn.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, when a creature succeeds on its Wisdom saving throw, it takes Psychic damage equal to {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Captivate
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 round

One creature you can perceive within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it gains the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. It loses that condition if it takes any damage.
On a success, it can't be affected by this talent for 24 hours.

psionic.name: Cognitive Sear
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦ ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

You send a white-hot vibration through the mind of a creature you can perceive within range, attempting to temporarily blank yourself from its senses. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage, and until the end of your next turn, it perceives you as though you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.
✦ If your target succeeds, your die remains unspent.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the creature takes additional damage equal to your psionic ability modifier, and you are {@condition Invisible|XPHB} to that creature for one minute. If you deal damage to it during that time, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

psionic.name: Dæmonic Figment
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦ ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You send waves of your psionic power forth to clash against the mental energy of a target. From the chaos, you form an ephemeral spirit, which you direct against that creature's psyche.

Choose a creature you can perceive within range. It makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage. For the duration, that creature is haunted by a frightening spirit.

At the beginning of each of its turns, the target can choose to {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on keeping the spirit at bay. Whenever that {@status Concentration|XPHB} lapses, and when the creature chooses not to begin {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} at the beginning of its turn, the creature takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage.
A creature with a Charisma score of 3 or less is immune to this talent.
✦ If your target succeeds, Tap the spent die instead of Exhausting it.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, your target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the initial saving throw.

psionic.name: Daze
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 round
One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, that creature can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the end of its next turn.
{@b Improvement} — Once you reach APL 11, that creature also can't take {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|Bonus Actions} until the end of its next turn. At 17+, it loses one Legendary Action.

psionic.name: Despair
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round
One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, Invest it with the spent die for the duration. When that die is Divested, Exhaust it.

Your target loses all {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While Invested, it can't gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to prevent the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, and it loses {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to those conditions. Now and at the beginning of each of the Invested creature's turns, it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}.
As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, the Invested creature can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, this talent's effects end early, and the die is Divested. On a failure, repeat the damage roll.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, each time you deal the target {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}, increase it by your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Domineer
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱⟱ (Exhaust 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

A creature you can perceive within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, your target takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Psychic damage. It has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the beginning of your next turn. While it is charmed, you control that creature during its turn, and it acts according to your will. You can only force it to move, to drop {@condition Prone|XPHB}, or to take the Attack Action this way.
✦ On a success, one of the dice of your choice remains unspent. Roll the other die and deal the target Psychic damage equal to the result.

{@i Heighten} — If you Exhaust at least one spirit shard to activate this talent, you can also force the creature to take the Activate a Talent action, Cast a Spell action, or another Action listed in its stat block.

psionic.name: Dreamer's Run
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous → which you take when a creature you can perceive moves within range
The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, each foot that creature moves this turn costs it 1 additional foot of movement.

psionic.name: Imagined Decoy
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓ (Tap 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

You form a psionic image of your body and send it forth, moving it up to your speed. It looks and moves like you, and while it exists, you can speak from its position, though it has no mass and cannot attack. It lasts until the end of your next turn. Each creature that sees the image makes a Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that succeed can easily discern the image as a projection and remain fully aware of your true location.
Creatures that fail believe the image to be you, and your true body is blanked from their perception temporarily while it persists.

The image disperses immediately if attacked by a creature that succeeded on the saving throw. If a creature that failed attacks it, the image has AC equal to your own, and {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the maximum roll of the dice spent to create it + your psionic ability modifier. It dissipates if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and all of its effects end.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard to activate this talent, you can replace any weapon attack you make with an attack from the image's position. That attack is a psionic melee attack with a reach of 5 feet, which uses your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls. It deals {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} damage instead of that weapon's normal damage.

psionic.name: Psychic Wound
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱⟱ (Exhaust 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

You force a creature that you can perceive within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Psychic damage and incurs a lasting wound to its psyche.

So long as that wound persists, at the beginning of each of its turns, that creature takes 1 Psychic damage. If that creature is engaged in a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, the rate of damage slows to 1 per 10 minutes. The wound cannot reduce the creature to less than 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

At the end of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, the afflicted creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the wound heals. The wound can also be removed by effects that remove diseases or curses from a target, though immunity to diseases or curses does not prevent the affliction.
✦ If your target succeeds, one die of your choice remains unspent.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard to activate this talent, the afflicted creature is unaware of both the wound and the damage that it causes. This does not prevent it from attempting saving throws at the end of rests.

psionic.name: Psychosomatic Link
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 2 Creatures
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|{@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}}

Choose one creature within range, then choose a second creature within 30 feet of the first. The first creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, for the next minute, whenever the second creature takes damage, the first creature takes half that much Psychic damage, rounded down.
This effect ends early if the creatures are more than 60 feet apart from one another at the beginning of your turn.

psionic.name: Relinquish
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} — / ✦⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
A creature you can sense within range makes a Charisma saving throw. If it fails, it drops an object of its choice that it is holding, which falls at its feet, or releases a creature it is grappling.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychokinesis
entries: If you have the Psychokinesis foundation, unlock the following effects.
{@i Heighten} — ✦ You can Tap 1 spirit shard when your target fails its save against this talent to immediately pull a dropped object to a point within 5 feet of you.

psionic.name: Sensory Projection
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓/✦⟱ (Tap/✦Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous/ ✦ 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You send out a portion of your consciousness, imbuing it with the power of your senses. You form a psionic sensory nexus, which can see, smell, taste, hear, and feel, then send it forth. It is unaffected by gravity, but can't pass through solid barriers or through openings less than 1 inch in diameter. It is invisible except to creatures that possess {@sense Truesight|XPHB}.
You can move it up to 30 feet or a distance equal to your psychic strike, whichever is greater. It fades at the end of your turn.
Your normal senses persist while the nexus grants you a point of perception. You briefly rearrange the workings of your mind so that you understand the conflicting viewpoints.

{@i Heighten} — ✦ If you Exhaust the spent die rather than Tap it, the sensor persists for 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} for the duration, you can move the nexus either 30 feet or a distance equal to the range of your psychic strike, whichever is greater.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you can use your psychophonics to speak telepathically from the nexus's location.

psionic.name: Sinister Susurration
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦ ⟱⟱→⥥⥥ (Exhaust → Invest 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You attempt to instill a harsh, whispering voice of doubt within a creature's consciousness.

A creature you can perceive within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, Invest the spent dice into it. Your power awakens a voice within the creature's own mind, which berates it, reminding it of all its past failures and all its potential future ones. It takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Psychic damage. For the duration, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws.
A creature with a Charisma score of 3 or less is unaffected by this Talent.
✦ If your target succeeds, one die of your choice remains unspent.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, that creature takes additional damage equal to your Psionic Ability modifier, and while Invested, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 Tests}.

psionic.name: Spirit Shake
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⇓→⥥ (Tap → Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

You assault a creature's spirit with targeted psionic pulses. That creature makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, Invest it with the Tapped die until the end of your next turn. Then it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage. When the Invested creature makes a saving throw, roll the Invested die, subtract the result from that saving throw, and then Divest it.
✦ If your target succeeds on the initial save, your die remains unspent.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, when you subtract it from a creature's roll, the creature takes that much Psychic damage.

psionic.name: Stigmatize
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round/✦1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
