You attempt to dredge up a creature's own stores of guilt, solidify them, and apply them to an act of your choosing. You choose one of the following acts:

items: Making an {@action Attack|XPHB}
Taking a {@action Magic|XPHB} action or casting a spell
Taking a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} or activating a talent
Making an ability check using an ability of your choice
Taking the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action
Using its movement to move 5 feet
An act not listed here. Your DM determines whether the stigma is a valid option; if it isn't, you choose another.

entries: One creature you can perceive within range is affected by the stigma. Each time it commits the chosen act before the beginning of your next turn, it makes a Charisma saving throw. Whenever it fails it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage.
A creature with a Charisma score of 3 or less is unaffected by this Talent.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, each time it takes damage, the creature takes additional damage equal to your psionic ability modifier, and the duration extends to ✦1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}.

psionic.name: Stream of Thought
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You weaponize your thoughts, sending forth a stream of unprocessed, jumbled psionic power, which is visible as an array of luminant geometric shapes.

A 5-foot-wide, 15-foot long {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} emanates from you in a direction of your choice. Each creature in that {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage.

Until the beginning of your next turn, until you move, or until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}, each creature that begins or ends its turn in the area of effect must also make this saving throw.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the length of the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} is doubled, and you can bend it once at an angle of either 45 or 90 degrees at one point along its length.

psionic.name: Stricken Record
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action | ✦ Trigger
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
A creature you can see within range makes an Intelligence saving throw. If it fails, it takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage and you choose one:

items: It loses {@status Concentration|XPHB}.
That creature loses the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, and/or {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition(s).

For one minute, it forgets one Magic or Psionic trait or feature of your choice that it used since the end of your last turn. It can't use it again until it recalls it. It can attempt to recall it early by taking an Action to make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check against your psionic save DC.

If an act caused that creature to be hostile to you within the last minute, it forgets about that act. For the next hour, at the end of every 10 minutes, it makes an Intelligence saving throw against your psionic save DC, recalling the information on a success. If the hour passes and it hasn't succeeded, it forgets permanently.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychic Strike
entries: If you have the Psychic Strike foundation, unlock the following effects.
{@i Heighten} — ✦ If you spend a spirit shard, you can ignore this talent's normal range and activate it targeting a creature when you damage that creature with psychic strike, no action required.

psionic.name: Syncopate
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⟱/✦⇓ (Exhaust/✦Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)} → which you take when a creature you can perceive within range activates a talent or takes a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}

You send arrhythmic pulses of psychic sound through a creature's mind, attempting to interrupt its talent or {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}. The triggering creature makes a saving throw with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} using its psionic ability, adding any psi dice spent to activate the triggering spell or action to its roll. You contest that save with a psionic ability check, adding the spent die to the roll. If you win the contest, the creature's talent or {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} fails and has no effect.
✦ If you lose the contest, Tap the spent die, rather than Exhausting it.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the Advantage during the contest shifts to you.

psionic.name: Telepathic Breach
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ → ✦⟱ (Tap → ✦Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You attempt to open the mind of another creature to your telepathic senses. One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it is aware of your intrusion attempt, the attempt fails, and for the next 8 hours, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves it makes against this talent.
On a failure, for the duration, you can listen to the creature's surface thoughts and perceive its active emotions, so long as it remains within your psychophonics range.
A creature with 3 or less Intelligence is unaffected by this Talent.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱ (Exhaust 1)

As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} during the duration, you can Exhaust the tapped die to seek the answer to one question within that creature's mind. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it detects your presence, and you discover nothing. On a failure, if the creature knows the answer, its mind provides it. Either way, your intrusion ends.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the duration is doubled. Additionally, the first time you seek the answer to a question, the spirit shard isn't Exhausted.

psionic.name: Thought Bubble
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You flood the spirit of a creature you touch with your psionic energy, pushing its deepest fears to the forefront. It makes a Charisma saving throw. If it fails, it takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} Psychic damage and emits an {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} with a range equal to your psychophonics range. All creatures within that {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} become aware of your target's deepest fear, its most dearly held regret, its lowest Ability Score, and a random {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} it possesses, if any.
✦ If your target succeeds on the saving throw, your die remains unspent.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychoformation
entries: If you have the Psychoformation foundation, unlock the following effects.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, when the creature fails, a {@creature Tulpa|QuetsPsionicVolI} representing the unleashed thoughts chews its way out of the creature's spirit, appearing atop that creature's head. You don't control the tulpa. It takes its turn immediately after yours and is unrelentingly hostile toward its progenitor, which has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to all damage the tulpa deals to it. The {@creature Tulpa|QuetsPsionicVolI} has {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice the damage dealt by this talent and adds your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to its attack rolls. It persists for one minute. It ceases to exist if it or the creature that spawned it dies.

psionic.name: Conveyance
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Long Rest
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} Vestment ✦
{@b Cost:} ⥥◊ (Invest 1 spirit shard)
{@b Duration:} ∞
✦ 1 nonmagical cape, cloak, dress, overcoat, scarf, or other loose vestment

Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you instill a faint shadow of consciousness into a mundane or psionic vestment, awakening within it a desire to assist its wearer. At the end of that rest, you don't refresh any Tapped or Exhausted psi dice, and you Invest 1 spirit shard into the chosen vestment. It remains Invested this way until you die or you take a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} to Divest it. If you are interrupted while Investing or Divesting the die, the process fails, and you Exhaust it instead. You can't Invest an item with this talent if another item is Invested by this talent.

entries.name: Flight
entries: While wearing the vestment, a creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} each increase by an amount determined by the rank of the invested die. This grants a creature one or both of those speeds if it lacks them.

items.name: Rank 0 (d2):
entries: 5 ft.

items.name: Rank 1 (d4):
entries: 10 ft.

items.name: Rank 2 (d6):
entries: 15 ft.

items.name: Rank 3 (d8):
entries: 20 ft.

items.name: Rank 4 (d10):
entries: 25 ft.

items.name: Rank 5 (d12):
entries: 30 ft.

items.name: Rank 6 (d20):
entries: 50 ft.

entries.name: Assistance
entries: When you hit or are hit by a melee attack, roll a {@dice d100}. If the result is less than or equal to your psionic ability score, the vestment responds autonomously.

items: If you were hit, they roll the invested die and reduce the damage by the result + your psionic ability modifier.
If you made the attack, the vestment entangles the target. It gains the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn or until you are 5 or more feet away from it.

psionic.name: Delineation
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} APL 5+
{@b Activation Time:} Long Rest
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} Weapon ✦
{@b Cost:} ⥥◊ (Invest 1 spirit shard)
{@b Duration:} ∞
✦ 1 nonmagical ranged weapon with which you are proficient
You have learned to move a portion of your spirit into a weapon, making it a part of yourself.

Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can meditate on a ranged weapon with which you are proficient, which can be mundane or psionic. If it requires attunement, you must be attuned to it before beginning this process. At the end of that rest, you don't refresh any Tapped or Exhausted psi dice, and you Invest 1 spirit shard into the chosen weapon. It remains Invested this way until you die or you spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} Divesting it. If you are interrupted while Investing or Divesting the die, the process fails, and you Exhaust it instead. You can't Invest an item with this talent if another item is Invested by this talent.

entries.name: Drawn by Spirit
entries: While this weapon is invested, you use your psionic ability, rather than another ability, for the attack and damage rolls of that weapon. Its short and long range double.

entries.name: Psi Bolts
entries: When the weapon lacks ammunition, it draws upon the Investment to fire a bolt of psionic power when you make a ranged attack with it, which deal {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Force damage instead of that weapon's normal damage.

entries.name: Delineate
entries: When you attack and hit a creature with the weapon, you can Tap the Invested die to demarcate a Sphere with a 15-foot radius around the target's current position, visible as a flat, glowing white circle regardless of the viewing angle. Your target can't be forced past that line. During its turn, it can attempt to move willingly past it. It makes a Charisma saving throw against your psionic save DC, breaking the circle on a success. On a failure, it can't try again until its next turn.

psionic.name: Division
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} Charisma 13+
{@b Activation Time:} Long Rest
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥◊ (Invest 1 spirit shard)
{@b Duration:} ∞
You have learned to germinate a seed from your own mind, budding off a portion of your spirit into an autonomous node called a dæmon.

You form the dæmon over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. At the end of that rest, you don't refresh any Tapped or Exhausted psi dice, and you Invest 1 spirit shard into yourself. It remains Invested this way until you die or you spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} Divesting it. If you are interrupted while Investing or Divesting the die, the process fails, and you Exhaust it instead. You can't craft another dæmon with this talent while one still exists.

Your dæmon isn't a creature, but merely a representation of your divided consciousness. You determine its appearance when it is created, though it is always Tiny, and can be seen only by you, creatures of your choice, and creatures with {@sense truesight}. When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and when you gain the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition, your dæmon is disabled until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

During your turn, you can move your dæmon up to 30 feet to a point that you can see. At the end of your turn, it returns immediately to your space unless you use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to assign it to a creature within 5 feet of it. If you do so, it stays with that creature until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.name: Dæmonic Proxy
entries: You can use psionic foundations and activate psionic talents as though you stood in the dæmon's space.

entries.name: Sculpted Spirit
entries: When you create your dæmon, it gains one of the following roles:

items.name: The Forceful
entries: Once per turn, when you or the creature to which your dæmon is assigned makes a damage roll, roll the dæmon's die and add or subtract the result from the damage.

items.name: The Capable
entries: Upon creation, choose an ability score. When you or a creature to which your dæmon is assigned makes a saving throw with that ability, roll the dæmon's die and add or subtract the result from that roll.

items.name: The Vengeful
entries: Once per turn, when you or the creature to which your dæmon is assigned takes damage from a creature, your dæmon deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage to the triggering creature.

items.name: The Willful
entries: When you activate a Zenithurgy talent, you can do so using your dæmon's die. When you do, your dæmon concentrates on that talent for you, the talent affects either you or a creature to which the dæmon is assigned, and your dæmon can be seen and attacked while concentrating. It doesn't take damage, but if attacked, it has an AC equal to your psionic save DC, and it makes saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} using your psionic ability, not Constitution. (Reminder: A creature can benefit from only one instance of a Zenithurgy talent.)

psionic.name: Endowment
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} APL 5+
{@b Activation Time:} Long Rest
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} Creature ✦
{@b Cost:} ⥥◊ (Invest 1 spirit shard)
{@b Duration:} ∞
✦ 1 willing creature with no psi dice

You've learned to endow another creature with a small spark of psionic power. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, during which you and your target must remain within 15 feet of one another, you can grant that creature some of your strength.

At the end of that rest, you don't refresh any Tapped or Exhausted psi dice, and you Invest 1 spirit shard into the chosen creature. It remains Invested this way until you die or you spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} Divesting it. If you are interrupted while Investing or Divesting the die, the process fails, and you Exhaust it instead. You can't Invest a creature with this talent if another creature is Invested by this talent.

Your target chooses Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. That ability becomes its psionic ability modifier for the talent it gained through this feature, and if that ability score is less than 10, it becomes 10 for as long as the creature remains invested.

Your target gains one of your psionic foundations of your choice, then learns either a raw talent or a talent from the discipline to which that foundation corresponds. The creature can't learn an Investiture talent this way.
The creature can spend the Invested spirit shard as though it were that creature's own. If Invested, it returns to Investing that creature when the new Investment concludes.

psionic.name: Extension
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} APL 5+
{@b Activation Time:} Long Rest
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} Weapon ✦
{@b Cost:} ⥥◊ (Invest 1 spirit shard)
{@b Duration:} ∞
✦ 1 nonmagical melee weapon with which you are proficient
You have learned to move a portion of your spirit into a weapon, making it a part of yourself.

Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can meditate on a melee weapon with which you are proficient, which can be mundane or psionic. If it requires attunement, you must be attuned to it before beginning this process. At the end of that rest, you don't refresh any Tapped or Exhausted psi dice, and you Invest 1 spirit shard into the chosen weapon. It remains Invested this way until you die or you spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} Divesting it. If you are interrupted while Investing or Divesting the die, the process fails, and you Exhaust it instead. You can't Invest an item with this talent if another item is Invested by this talent.

entries.name: Animus
entries: You wield the weapon using your mind, rather than your body. You use your psionic ability modifier, rather than another ability, when making attack and damage rolls with the invested weapon. While drawn, it hovers close to your body. When you make an attack with it, it either strikes from your space, or travels to a space that you can see within a range determined by the rank of the invested die, then strikes from there. Immediately afterward, it returns to your vicinity.

items.name: Rank 0 (d2):
entries: 5 ft.

items.name: Rank 1 (d4):
entries: 10 ft.

items.name: Rank 2 (d6):
entries: 15 ft.

items.name: Rank 3 (d8):
entries: 20 ft.

items.name: Rank 4 (d10):
entries: 25 ft.

items.name: Rank 5 (d12):
entries: 30 ft.

items.name: Rank 6 (d20):
entries: 50 ft.

entries.name: Spirit Force
entries: Once per turn when you hit with an attack roll with the weapon, it deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} additional Force damage.

psionic.name: Warding
entries: {@b Prerequisite:} APL 5+
{@b Activation Time:} Long Rest
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} Weapon ✦
{@b Cost:} ⥥◊ (Invest 1 spirit shard)
{@b Duration:} ∞
✦ 1 nonmagical shield with which you have training
You have learned to move a portion of your spirit into a shield, making it a part of yourself.

Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can meditate on a shield with which you have training, which can be mundane or psionic. If it requires attunement, you must be attuned to it before beginning this process. At the end of that rest, you don't refresh any Tapped or Exhausted psi dice, and you Invest 1 spirit shard into the chosen shield. It remains Invested this way until you die or you spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} Divesting it. If you are interrupted while Investing or Divesting the die, the process fails, and you Exhaust it instead. You can't Invest an item with this talent if another item is Invested by this talent.

entries.name: Animate Protector
entries: The shield hovers near your body, protecting you as though you were wielding it, without requiring you to hold it in hand. As normal, your AC doesn't benefit from the effects of multiple shields.

entries.name: Protect
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can send the shield to protect another creature you can see within a range determined by the rank of the Invested die. It returns to you at the start of your next turn. Until that time, that creature benefits from the shield as though bearing it and proficient with it.

items.name: Rank 0 (d2):
entries: 5 ft.

items.name: Rank 1 (d4):
entries: 10 ft.

items.name: Rank 2 (d6):
entries: 15 ft.

items.name: Rank 3 (d8):
entries: 20 ft.

items.name: Rank 4 (d10):
entries: 25 ft.

items.name: Rank 5 (d12):
entries: 30 ft.

items.name: Rank 6 (d20):
entries: 50 ft.

entries.name: Repercussion
entries: When a creature misses you or a creature your shield is protecting with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a melee psionic attack against the triggering creature from your shield's position. On a hit, that creature takes Force damage equal to {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Arcbow
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥+ →⟱ (Invest 1+ → ✦Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

You Invest the spent die into the formation of a heavy bow of solidified numena, which appears in your hand. It is a psionic weapon with following properties. You have proficiency with it, but other creatures can't wield it.
After the bow forms, you can immediately make one attack with it using the die Invested to form it.
{@i Heighten} — If the bow is Invested with at least one spirit shard, you have mastery with it.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: To make any future ranged attack with the bow, you must Invest an additional die, which becomes the damage die for that attack. ✦ Then, if the bow has a number of Invested equal to or greater than your psionic ability modifier, you must immediately make another attack with it as part of the same action. Dismiss the bow, Divest all dice Invested into it, Exhaust one, then roll them all. On a hit, this attack deals Force damage equal to the result + your psionic ability modifier. {@hom} It then explodes in a 15-foot {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on your target. Roll the dice again. Each creature in the sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the new result on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

{@i Heighten} — If you Exhaust a spirit shard for the bow's final attack, creatures that fail the Dexterity saving throw gain the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn.

psionic.name: Assailance Node
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 feet
{@b Target:} A point within range which you have seen within the last minute
{@b Cost:} ⥥x →⟱ (Invest X → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

You manifest a glowing, crystallized node of psionic power at the chosen point and Invest it with one or more psi dice, up to a maximum equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can only have one active assailance node at any time. The node has AC equal to your psionic save DC, and it uses that DC as its d20 result if forced to make a saving throw. It is immune to all conditions other than {@condition Stunned|XPHB}. If it would take any amount of damage, instead you Divest one of its Invested dice.

At the end of your turn, you Divest one die from the node. It makes a ranged psionic attack against a creature of your choice within 60 feet of itself, or against your nearest enemy, if you don't choose a target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage. When you Divest the node's last die, Exhaust that die. The node disappears after it makes its final attack.
{@i Heighten} — When you Divest a spirit shard to attack with the node, the attack deals additional Psychic damage equal to your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Astral Construct
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft.
{@b Target:} A point within range which you have seen within the last minute
{@b Cost:} ⥥x →⟱ (Invest X → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You craft a body of pure numena and inscribe it with psionic directives that allow it to act with moderate autonomy.

When you create the construct, you Invest one or more psi dice to act as its {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice}. Its {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point maximum} is equal to the total maximum value of those dice + your psionic ability modifier. Upon creation, you choose the construct's basic appearance, whether it is bipedal or quadrupedal, and whether it is Small or Medium. Its psionic ability score is equal to your own. When you create it, choose one of its other ability scores. That score becomes 14. All others remain 10. As shown in the Astral Construct stat block, it uses your proficiency bonus (PB) and psionic ability modifier (PM) in some places, and uses the ֎ symbol to indicate when a stat or feature mirrors your own.

In combat, the astral construct acts alongside you during your turn. It can move and use its {@variantrule Action|XPHB|Actions} and {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} on its own, though it always acts according to your will. It can take basic actions or the actions described in its stat block.

The astral construct disappears when it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, when the duration expires, or if you use this talent again. When the construct ceases to be, Exhaust one of the Invested dice and Divest the rest.

{@i Heighten} — For each spirit shard you Invest, the construct's {@variantrule Hit Point maximum|XPHB} further increases by your psionic ability modifier. If you invest at least one, you can create a specialized construct: Breaker, Guard, or Harrier, each with unique abilities as described in the stat block.

psionic.name: Chakram
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You construct a unique psionic weapon, a hollow discus with a razor-sharp edge, which appears in your open hand. It has the following properties.

For the duration, you have proficiency and mastery with the chakram, and you can use your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls. When thrown for an attack, it returns to your hand immediately after the attack hits or misses.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychokinesis
entries: If you have the Psychokinesis foundation, unlock the following effects.

Whenever you hit with the chakram when making a ranged attack, you can immediately make an attack against a new target you can see within 30 feet of the previous target, delaying the chakram's return. You can't make this bonus attack against a target you've already attacked with the chakram this turn, and you don't add your ability modifier to the damage of any bonus attacks you make. You also don't add it to the attack rolls of any bonus attacks you make beyond the second.
{@i Heighten} — You add your ability modifier to the damage of the first two bonus attacks you make with the chakram each turn.

psionic.name: Exoskeleton
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Bonus Action; or Reaction, which you take when you or a creature within 30 feet of you falls
{@b Range:} 30 feet
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You Invest a psi die into the creation of a supportive, quasi-skeletal structure, which snaps into being around you or a willing creature you can see within range, granting it several benefits.

entries.name: Protection
entries: That creature gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the highest value on the invested die + your psionic ability modifier.

entries.name: Bracing
entries: A creature wearing the exoskeleton subtracts 100 feet when calculating damage taken from a fall.
The creature's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} extra Piercing damage on a hit.

entries.name: Knuckle Spikes
entries: The exoskeleton disappears immediately when the creature has no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} remaining.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, for the duration, the target has a damage threshold equal to the value of its current {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. This threshold can't exceed the maximum value of the invested die.

psionic.name: Flux Matrix
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 feet
{@b Target:} 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}
{@b Cost:} ⥥⥥⥥+ (Invest 3 or more )
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You draw from the aethers to form a semi-real, 15-foot Cube, the properties of which shift at the flick of your will.
When you craft the cube, Invest it with 3 or more psi dice. Whenever a ranged attack passes through any portion of the matrix, you assign one Invested die to each of any number of the choices below:

items: On a hit, the attack deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} extra damage.
On a hit, reduce the damage dealt by the attack by {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]}.
Change the damage type of that attack to Force or Psychic damage.
Double that attack's range(s).
As it either enters or leaves the matrix, the attack travels only 10 feet further. If it travels more than 5 feet, the attack roll has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entries: Divest each die you assigned this way at the end of the turn you assign it. The matrix disappears immediately if it has no Invested dice.
{@i Heighten} — The first time you assign each spirit shard to choose an effect, you don't Divest that shard.

psionic.name: Hone
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} A melee weapon or shield
{@b Cost:} ⥥ (Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

You touch a mundane or psionic melee weapon or a shield and Invest it with one of your psi dice for the duration, grant it a psionic coating that makes it more deadly. While so Invested, the object deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} extra damage when a creature makes an attack with it and hits.
You can Divest the die early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Divest it automatically when it rolls its maximum value.
{@i Heighten} — If you Invest a spirit shard, when it rolls its maximum value, roll it a second time before Divesting it when determining the extra damage.

psionic.name: Interdiction
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft.
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⟱⟱⟱ (Exhaust 3)
{@b Duration:} 1 round/✦1-4 rounds

A triangular prism of psionic energy springs up and into being around a creature you can perceive within range. That creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, until the beginning of your next turn, that creature enters a form of stasis. While it can still think, it can't or affect the world in any way. During that time, targeted effects and area effects that would target or affect the creature are directed at the prism instead.

The prism has an AC of 15, and instead of rolling saving throws, it treats every result as a 15. Make note of any damage, Conditions, regained {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, or other effects applied to the prism. When the prism dissipates, the imprisoned creature takes half of the marked damage, regains half of the marked {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and is fully affected by the rest of the marked effects.
{@i Heighten} — ✦ For each spirit shard you spend, the prism persists for one additional round, lasting until the beginning of another of your turns after its duration would have ended.

psionic.name: Lightpost
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 feet
{@b Target:} A point within range
{@b Cost:} —/✦ ⥥ (Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute/✦ ∞

A gleaming staff with a 6-foot haft appears in an unoccupied space within range, tipped by a glowing lantern. The lantern sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet, which can be any color like from among those you can perceive. It appears balanced perfectly on its tip, though it can easily be knocked over or grasped as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.
The lightpost disappears early if you use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to dismiss it.
✦ If you Invest the lightpost, it persists until you dismiss it. An Invested lightpost is a psionic weapon with the following properties. You have proficiency with it.

psionic.name: Maintenance Node
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft.
{@b Target:} A point within range which you have seen within the last minute
{@b Cost:} ⥥x→⟱ (Invest X → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

You manifest a glowing, crystallized node of psionic power at the chosen point and Invest it with one or more psi dice, up to a maximum equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can only have one active maintenance node at any time. The node has AC equal to your psionic save DC, and it uses that DC as its d20 result if forced to make a saving throw. It is immune to all conditions other than {@condition Stunned|XPHB}. If it would take any amount of damage, instead you Divest one of its Invested dice.

At the end of your turn, you Divest one die from the node and choose a creature within 60 feet of the node. The chosen creature gains {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result. If you don't choose a target, the node targets your nearest ally, first prioritizing the ally with the most {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}, then the ally with the lowest combined {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} + {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. When you Divest the node's last die, Exhaust that die. The node then disappears.
{@i Heighten} — When you Divest a spirit shard, the node grants additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your psionic ability modifier.

psionic.name: Mantis Claw
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱/✦⇓ (Invest → Exhaust/✦Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

A striking, raptorial claw forms, attached to your shoulder or another portion of your torso by a fractal lattice. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make a melee psionic attack with the claw, which has a reach of 5 feet. On a hit, it deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Piercing damage.
When the Invested die is Divested, Exhaust it. ✦ If it is Divested when you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} after failing a save to maintain it, Tap the die instead.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, when the claw hits with a melee attack, the target gains the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, with an escape DC equal to your psionic save DC.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychic Strike
entries: If you have the Psychic Strike foundation, unlock the following effects.
When you attack with the claw, you can make a ranged psionic attack, with a range equal to that of your psychic strike. On a hit, you can pull yourself up to 30 feet toward your target.

psionic.name: Null Sphere
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 30 feet
{@b Target:} A point you can see within range
{@b Cost:} ⟱⟱ (Exhaust 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

A faceted {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} with a 15-foot radius expands outward from the chosen point. Within the sphere, the wavelengths of mental energy are shaped and regimented. Each creature within the sphere has its strong emotions suppressed, temporarily suspending the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, though the suppressed effects resume if their duration exceeds that of the sphere.

Within the sphere, psionic effects of creatures are suppressed or nullified. Talents and other psionic abilities, such as psychokinesis, can't be used within, and their effects can't pass into it. Divine entities, such as deities, are immune to the effects of the sphere, and psionic items are unaffected.

When a creature with an Intelligence score of 3 or more attempts to willingly pass through the borders of the sphere, it must take a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} to attempt an Intelligence check against your spell save DC. On a failure, it can't pass through the borders until it succeeds on a future attempt. On a failure, it can pass freely in and out of the sphere for the duration of this talent.
{@i Heighten} — Whenever a creature passes in or out of the sphere, it takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Psychic damage.

psionic.name: Passkey
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} 10 feet
{@b Target:} A point within range
{@b Cost:} —/✦ ⥥ ( Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute/✦ ∞

You craft a Tiny morphic key which — in theory — can be used to unlock anything. You can use it as though it were {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB} when attempting to pick a lock. When you do, you can use your psionic ability modifier for the ability check, but you don't add your proficiency bonus unless you have proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}.
✦ If you Invest the key, it persists until you dismiss it. An Invested key is a psionic weapon with the following properties. You have proficiency with it.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you have mastery with the key.

psionic.name: Permeate
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} 30 feet
{@b Target:} A damaged object or creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓ (Tap 2)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You can't target a creature or object with this talent if it has full {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
You attempt to fill the damaged portions of your target with imagined matter, then expand it, drastically worsening that damage.
If you target a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@footnote 2[✧✧]|Use two different spent dice X times.} Slashing {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}.

If you target an object, it takes an amount of Slashing {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} equal to its missing {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} + {@footnote 4[✧✧]|Use two different spent dice X times.}.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard, a targeted creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.

psionic.name: Piercing Rain
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft.
{@b Target:} Another target
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓ (Tap 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

You form a dense cloud of crystalline needles, which then rain down in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} originating from a point you can see within range. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. Roll the tapped dice and sum their ranks. On a failure, a creature takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} + your psionic ability modifier in Slashing damage, plus additional damage equal to sum of the die's ranks for each size category that creature is above Medium. If it is Large or larger, it takes half damage even on a success.

The needles embed into any solid surface that they strike, creating an area of {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. A creature can make an attack against the needles to attempt to clear a 5-foot square of them. They have an AC equal to your psionic ability modifier and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. When a creature enters the {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, it takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Piercing damage, but clears a 5-foot square of the needles.
Any uncleared needles dissolve into nonexistence when the talent ends.
{@i Heighten} — The cube's size increases by 5 feet for each spirit shard tapped to activate this talent.

psionic.name: Projected Barrier
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} 30 ft.
{@b Target:} A point you choose within range
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You are able to create barriers of solid psionic energy, which block both vision and physical passage.

A softly glowing, opaque wall of force springs into existence at a point you can see within range. You choose the color of the glow, though it is just enough to illuminate the wall itself with {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. The wall is composed of 5-foot-by-5-foot panels with no thickness, the maximum number of which is determined by Rank of the spent die.

items: 0: 1 panel
1: 2 panels
2: 3 panels
3: 4 panels
4: 5 panels
5: 6 panels
6: 12 panels

entries: The side of each panel must be contiguous with the side of at least one other panel, though the panels can appear horizontally, vertically, or in any orientation you choose. The barrier cannot intersect creatures or solid objects when created, though you can make a panel smaller than its maximum size, and you can shape the edges of the panels to create a seal against a surface.

The panels share {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, with a maximum equal to the highest value on the psi die tapped to activate this ability + your psionic ability modifier. It has an AC equal to your psionic ability modifier.

The barrier can support weight, though the first time a creature moves 5 or more feet while supported by the barrier each turn, the barrier loses 1d6 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for each size category that creature is above Small.

The barrier lasts for one minute, until its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are depleted, or until you dismiss it, which you can do as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can maintain only one barrier at a time. If you activate this talent again, your existing barrier vanishes.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this ability, double the barrier's {@variantrule Hit Point maximum|XPHB}.

psionic.name: Shell
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥/✦⇓ (Invest/✦ Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 8 hours

You Invest one of your psi dice into yourself, creating an invisible barrier of energy that takes damage before you do. You gain {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. If this alleviates any {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}, Tap the Invested die. Divest the die when you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} remaining.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you gain additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your psionic ability modifier. When you take damage that reduces your {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} to 0, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the rest of that damage.

psionic.name: Surveillance Node
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} A point within range which you have seen within the last minute
{@b Cost:} ⥥x→⟱ (Invest X → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute/invested die

You manifest a glowing, crystallized node of psionic power at the chosen point and Investing it with one or more psi dice, up to a maximum equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can only have one active surveillance node at any time. The node has AC equal to your psionic save DC, and it uses that DC as its d20 result if forced to make a saving throw. It is immune to all conditions other than {@condition Stunned|XPHB}. If it would take any amount of damage, instead you Divest one of its Invested dice.

The node can see and hear as though it were you, and you are aware of everything it perceives. At the end of your turn, you Divest one die from the node. Then, if you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, you make your choice of an {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Investigation|XPHB}, or {@skill Perception|XPHB} check from the node's position, using your psionic ability rather than the ability normally called for by that roll. Roll the Divested die and add it to the result of that check.
{@i Heighten} — While the node has at least one Invested spirit shard, it has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychophonics
entries: If you have the Psychophonics foundation, unlock the following effects.
You can activate psychophonics talents as though you occupied the node's position.

psionic.name: Tiger's Fang
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You construct a unique psionic weapon, a piercing, fanglike stiletto set into a simple hilt, which appears in your open hand. It has the following properties.
For the duration, you have proficiency and mastery with the stiletto, and you can use your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the stiletto deals an additional {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Thunder damage on a hit.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychotelechy
entries: If you have the Psychotelechy foundation, unlock the following effects.
You can shape a second stiletto, which appears in another open hand. Both weapons count as psiblades for features that modify the function of psiblades.

psionic.name: Titan's Gauntlet
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} 10 feet
{@b Target:} A creature within range
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

You construct a unique psionic weapon, a gauntlet of solidified numena, which appears worn by you or a willing creature within range. It seamlessly overlays anything else worn on the target's hand. It has the following properties.
When he Invested die Divests, Exhaust it.

A creature wearing the gauntlet can attack with it as if it were either a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. When attacking with the gauntlet as an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the attack can use both the {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Damage} and either the {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Grapple} or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Shove} option of the {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you and allies wielding this weapon have mastery with it.

psionic.name: Titan's Knife
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} 10 feet
{@b Target:} A point with range
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute
You construct a unique psionic weapon, an oversized sword of solidified numena, which appears in the open hand of you or a creature within range. It has the following properties.
When he Invested die Divests, Exhaust it.

When making a weapon attack, rather than a single target, a creature attacking with the knife can select up to three targets within its reach, chosen in sequence, though it uses the same attack roll for each target. Each target must be within 5 feet of the previous target.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you and allies wielding this weapon have mastery with it.

psionic.name: Vantage
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action; or ✦1 Reaction, which you take when you become the target of an attack
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}; or ✦ 1 round

You weave together ambient numena to swiftly craft a column beneath your feet. A shimmering, crystalline pillar in the shape of a 5-foot-diameter, 20-foot high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}, springs up beneath your feet, carrying you upward. It stops growing if it encounters any resistance beyond your weight and that of anything you are wearing or carrying. Though clearly psionic in nature, the pillar has the properties of stone.

While standing on the pillar, you gain a {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} bonus to all Strength and Dexterity saving throws. The tower vanishes when you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}, when the duration expires, when you are no longer standing on it, or when you dismiss it, which you can do as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. It sinks into the ground when it vanishes, rather than dropping you from height.

✦ {@i Heighten} — You can spend a spirit shard to activate this talent as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. If the triggering attack is a melee attack and your change in position carries you out of range, the attack misses. If it's a ranged attack, that attack has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If you activate this talent as a Reaction, the pillar vanishes at the end of your next turn.

psionic.name: Woven Limb
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 action
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 hour

You touch a creature and Invest it with one of your psi dice, weaving your numena, the target's, and the ambient numena of the world into a threefold pattern to form a functional arm extending from a point on that creature's body of the target's choice.
While the arm persists, the creature treats it as a functional arm, though it is slightly weaker and less dextrous than a natural one.

╢The arm can't wield weapons without the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|light} property, and if a creature uses only that limb to grapple or shove a creature, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the saving throw to avoid that condition and to free itself from the grapple.╟
A creature can bear only one woven limb at a time.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, ignore the text enclosed in ╢╟. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, the creature bearing the arm can use it to make one {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} or to attack with a weapon with the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property.

psionic.name: Accretion Well
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range makes a Strength saving throw. Each creature that fails is moved 10 feet toward the chosen point. Each time this movement causes any creature that failed the save to make contact with a creature, object, or solid surface, the failure takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Bludgeoning damage.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the creatures are moved 20, rather than 10, feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, the area within the Sphere is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for your enemies.

psionic.name: Barrage
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 5 ft.
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⟱ → ✦ ⇓x (Exhaust 1 → ✦Tap x)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You empower your spiritual limbs to pummel your target. Make a melee psionic attack against your target. On a hit, you deal Psychic damage equal to {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: On a hit, you can ✦ ⇓ Tap 1 to repeat this talent targeting the same creature, using the new die as {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]}. You can continue to further this talent a total number of times equal to your psionic ability modifier.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the creatures are moved 20, rather than 10, feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, the area within the Sphere is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for your enemies.

psionic.name: Burden
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 round

One creature you can perceive within range makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, until the beginning of your next turn, that creature suffers a -1 penalty to AC, to weapon attack rolls, and to Strength and Dexterity saving throws. During that time, when it takes damage as a result of falling, it has Vulnerability to that damage.
{@b Improvement} — Once you reach APL 11, the penalty increases to -2.

psionic.name: Deflect
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Reaction →
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ Tap 1
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous → which you take when a creature you can see within range is hit by a weapon attack
Reduce the critical hit range of the triggering attack by 1. Reduce the damage from that attack by {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, also add your character level to the reduction.

psionic.name: Diminish
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦ ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You attempt to pull apart a creature's physical form, reducing its integrity.

A creature you can perceive within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, your target takes Necrotic damage equal to {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum} lowers by the damage taken. If it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} following a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, it recovers from this reduction.
✦ If your target succeeds, your die remains unspent.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, your target takes half damage even on a success, and the reduction can be removed only by effects such as {@spell lesser restoration|XPHB}.

psionic.name: Distress
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK} or {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} 1 creature or object
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You send destructive vibrations through the physical form of a target you can see within range. If you target a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 5d4;5d6;5d8;5d10;5d12|5[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier in Force {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}.

If you target an unattended object, it takes this damage without making a save, but a creature attending an object can make an {@skill Arcana|XPHB} check against your spell save DC to prevent the object from taking damage.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, this talent deals non-temporary Force damage.

entries.name: Synthesis: Psychophonics
entries: If you have the Psychokinesis foundation, unlock the following effects.

If you have the psychophonics foundation, you can force a creature to make an {@skill Arcana|XPHB} check to resist this talent, rather than a Constitution saving throw. A creature that fails either the save or the check gains the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. It can attempt an Intelligence (Arcana) check as an action to end that condition early.

psionic.name: Gravitic Flux
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}
{@b Cost:} ⇓⟱ (Tap 1 + Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You send out a rolling field of gravity-disrupting force.

Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|cone} makes a Strength saving throw. Roll the spent dice. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to the combined result + your psionic ability modifier. Your power then lifts it 10 feet straight up, then drops it. It falls if unsupported.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard, your target takes half damage of the Force damage even on a successful save.

psionic.name: Hammer
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 10 ft.
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You slam a nearby creature downward with a burst of pressure. Make a melee psionic attack against the target. On a hit, roll the tapped die twice. Your target takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} Bludgeoning damage and you push it 10 feet straight down. It makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it drops any items held in its hands and anything else it is carrying.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, that creature takes additional damage equal to your psionic ability modifier, and if it begins on a surface or the movement causes it to impact a surface, it gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

psionic.name: Kinetic Pulse
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓ (Tap 2)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous
You cause a burst of force that slams outward, impacting nearby creatures. It releases a deep, audible thump, which can be heard up to 150 feet away.

Each creature within a 15-foot {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw and a Strength saving throw. Creatures that fail the Constitution saving throw take {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Thunder damage are {@condition Deafened|XPHB} for 30 seconds. Creatures that fail the Strength saving throw take {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Bludgeoning damage and are pushed 15 feet away from the point of origin. Use a different spent die for each damage type.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you can change either or both damage types to Force. Creatures that succeed on a saving throw take all damage changed to Force this way, but avoid the secondary effects.

psionic.name: Kinetic Vortex
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

A vortex of power sweeps around you, carrying you forth. Roll the Exhausted die. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet of must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Force damage.

The vortex carries you up to 30 feet in any direction. If it carries you within 5 feet of a creature, that creature takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Force damage. A creature can take this additional damage only once during a turn.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, add your psionic ability modifier to the initial damage.

psionic.name: Kinetic Ward
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥ → ⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 10 minutes {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You craft a ward that repels physical attacks.
Whenever you become the target of a weapon attack, roll the Invested die and add the result to your AC for that attack.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, it no longer requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

psionic.name: Psi-Lance
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}-Line
{@b Cost:} ✦⟱/⇓ (Exhaust/Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

A line of pure force, 5 feet wide and with length equal either to 30 feet or to the range of your psychic strike, bursts forth from your mind in a direction of your choice. Each creature in that line makes a Strength saving throw. Each creature that fails the save takes Force damage equal to {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier, then all such creatures are either pushed 10 feet directly away from you along the line or pulled 10 feet directly toward you.
On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't moved.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, you can ✦ Tap that die instead of Exhausting it.

psionic.name: Psycho Cutter
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 15 ft. | {@optfeature Psychic Strike|QuetsPsionicVolI|PS}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You compress a strand of numena into an impossibly thin crescent. Make a melee psionic attack against a creature you can perceive within range. That attack's {@variantrule Critical Hit Range|QuetsPsionicVolI} is expanded by 1. On a hit, your target takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier in Slashing damage.

{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard to activate this talent, its {@variantrule Critical Hit Range|QuetsPsionicVolI} is instead expanded by 3. On a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, refresh that spirit shard.

psionic.name: Rise
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 Round

A Medium or smaller creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, you lift it up to 10 feet straight up. It floats there until the beginning of its next turn, at which point it falls unless it has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB|flying speed}.
{@b Improvement} — You can affect larger creatures and lift them higher when you reach levels 11 (Large, 20 feet) and 17 (Huge, 30 feet).

psionic.name: Shear
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 10 ft.
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓⇓ (Tap 2)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You compress your will into two hardened lines of power which immediately snap inward, attempting to shear through the flesh of your target. For each spent die, you make a melee psionic attack against a creature you can see within range. Each attack deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier in Slashing damage. If both attacks hit, each does an extra {@dice 1d6} damage.

{@b Improvement} — When you reach level 11, when you attack a creature that has at least one head with this talent and roll a 20 on both attack rolls, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it has more than 50% of its remaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, if it is immune to Slashing damage, if it doesn't have or need a head, or if it has any Legendary Actions.
{@i Heighten} — For each spirit shard you spend on this talent, the beheading effect triggers on a roll of 19 or 20 for that die's attack roll, and that attack deals an extra {@dice 1d6} damage.

psionic.name: Shove
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action or ✦ Reaction →
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}
{@b Cost:} ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous ✦ → which you take when you are hit by a melee attack

You slam your willpower forth, pushing against everything within a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|cone}. Each creature in that cone makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature is pushed 15 feet away from you, then takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} + your psionic ability modifier in Bludgeoning damage.
On a success, a creature suffers no damage and is pushed only 5 feet.
{@i Heighten} — You may spend a spirit shard to activate this talent as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

psionic.name: Slingshot
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You stir the numena around you into a gravitic whorl. For the duration, whenever you become the target of a mundane ranged attack, roll the Tapped die. If the result is 4 or greater, the attacker becomes the new target of their own attack, which spins around you and launches anew from your position. On a hit, that creature doesn't add its ability score to the damage of that attack.
{@i Heighten} — You add your psionic ability modifier to the damage of the redirected attack.

entries.name: Synthesis: Psychoformation
entries: If you have the Psychoformation foundation, unlock the following effects.
A ring of orbiting planetoids coalesce within your miniature gravity well, giving you the chance to reflect non-mundane attacks, so long as you are the only target of the triggering attack.

psionic.name: Slip Disk
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action | ✦✦ Trigger
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} —/✦⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

Choose a creature you can see, which must be standing on a surface. You form a flat disk of force beneath that creature's feet, then whisk it away. Your target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or gain the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. ✦ If you Tap 1, it also takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Synthesis: Psychic Strike
entries: If you have the Psychic Strike foundation, unlock the following effects.
{@i Heighten} — ✦✦ If you spend a spirit shard, you can ignore this talent's normal range and activate it targeting a creature when you damage that creature with psychic strike, no action required.

psionic.name: Syzygy
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action or ✦ Reaction →
{@b Range:} 60 feet
{@b Target:} 2 Creatures
{@b Cost:} ✦⇓⇓ →⥥⥥ (✦ Tap → Invest 2)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

Choose two creatures you can see within range which are within 30 feet of each other. Each of those creatures makes a Strength saving throw. If both fail, Invest each creature with one of the Tapped dice. Both creatures take {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Force damage.

For the duration, neither of those creatures can willingly move if that movement would take it more than 15 feet from the other creature. A creature that begins its turn outside of this range must attempt to spend movement to move back within 15 feet of the other creature.

Once per turn when either creature moves beyond 15 feet from the other, or when a creature ends its turn further than 30 feet from the other, both creatures take {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Force damage.
✦ If at least one target succeeds, choose one of the dice to remain unspent.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend at least one spirit shard and you choose yourself as one of the targets, you are immune to damage from this talent.

psionic.name: Thrust
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action | ✦ Trigger
{@b Range:} Touch
{@b Target:} 1 creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓ (Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} Instantaneous

You collect a thrumming force in your open palm. Make a melee psionic attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, it takes {@damage 2d4;2d6;2d8;2d10;2d12|2[✧]} Force damage and you push it 10 feet away from you.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you deal additional damage equal to your psionic ability modifier, and you can push the target in any direction.

entries.name: Synthesis: Psychotelechy
entries: If you have the Psychotelechy foundation, unlock the following effects.
✦ Once per turn, you can activate this talent targeting a creature when you hit that creature with a psiblade, no action required.

psionic.name: Unburden
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 creature or object
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You lessen gravity's pull on a creature or object you can see within range. For the duration, your target's weight is halved.

items: If your target is a creature, for the duration, its jump distance is increased by your psionic ability modifier, and it has resistance to fall damage.

If your target is a weapon, it gains the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property for the duration. (A weapon with both the {@itemProperty H|XPHB|Heavy} and the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} properties benefits from neither.)

entries: Either way, if your target would be pushed or otherwise forcefully moved in a direction against its will while this effect persists, it is moved twice as far.

psionic.name: Unseat
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychokinesis|QuetsPsionicVolI|PK}
{@b Target:} 1 Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦ ⇓→⥥ (Tap→Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 round

A creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, Invest it with the Tapped die until the end of your next turn. It takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Force damage. While Invested by this talent, each time it is dealt damage (including now), it is dealt 1 extra Force damage for each of your dice Invested into it.
✦ If your target succeeds, your die remains unspent.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the first time the invested creature takes damage each turn, it takes an additional {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Force damage.

psionic.name: Adamant's Raiment
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} Invest 2 → Exhaust 1
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest two of your psi dice back into yourself to weave together a shimmering raiment of pure force. It grants you the following bonuses:

items: If you would take non-{@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you instead take half of that damage, rounded up, as {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}.

When you deal damage with a psionic attack, talent, or foundation, you can alleviate 2 {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} to deal an extra {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} damage of the same type.

When you activate a talent and miss all attacks with that talent, or when all creatures that make a saving throw against that talent succeed, you can alleviate 3 {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}. If you do, dice you Tapped or Exhausted to pay for that talent become unspent.

entries: When this talent ends, Divest the Invested dice, then Exhaust one of them.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychokinesis
entries: If you have the Psychokinesis foundation, unlock the following effects.

items: The range of psychokinesis increases by 30 feet.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can alleviate 4 {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI} to make a crushing, melee psionic attack against a creature within range of your psychokinesis. On a hit, it takes {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Force damage. If it takes at least 8 Force damage this way, it gains the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

psionic.name: Apsis
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You focus ambient numena into your palms, giving them a faint sheen of surreality. Your reach extends by 5 feet.

{@b Improvement} — At APL 5+, you can make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} against creatures that move away from you while within your reach, not just those that leave your reach. Your reach extends further when you reach APL 11 (10 feet) and 17 (15 feet).

psionic.name: Bands of Ardor
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest the spent die into yourself to manifest cords of conceptual flame, which twist in the air around your body, bolstering your psionic power and granting you the following benefits:

items: You can add the Invested die to {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Performance|XPHB}.
You shed {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 10 foot radius.
Once per turn when a creature takes damage from one of your Talents, psionic class features, or psionic foundations, you can deal it an additional {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Fire damage.

entries: The bands last until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested into you for the duration. When you Divest it, Exhaust it.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage for the duration.

psionic.name: Bands of Might
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest one of your psi dice into yourself to manifest cords of power, which snap into place around your wrists and ankles, bolstering your body and granting you the following benefits:

items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 tests} using {@skill Athletics|XPHB} or {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls you make with weapons.

When you use the {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Shove} option of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, roll the Invested die and add it to your save DC. You can push your target 5 additional feet.

entries: The bands last until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested into you for the duration. When you Divest it, Exhaust it.

{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, for the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make to avoid the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions.

psionic.name: Blade of Hope
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥⥥→⟱ (Invest 2 → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You manifest a blade of solidified hope which brightens the air around it with an aura of joy. It functions as a psiblade, but with the following alterations:

items: Both dice spent to manifest the blade become the blade's damage dice.
It deals Radiant damage.
The blade's reach is extended by 10 feet.
When you deal damage to a creature with the blade, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt, which you lose when you dismiss the blade.

entries: When you dismiss the blade or lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on it, Exhaust one of the Invested dice and Divest the other.
{@i Heighten} — If you Invested at least one spirit shard, you add it to Constitution saving throws you make to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this talent.

psionic.name: Blade of Storms
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You manifest a special psiblade of voltaic numena. It has the following special features:

items: It deals Lightning damage.
It deals additional Lightning damage equal to your psionic ability modifier to targets which are made of metal, wearing metal armor, or vulnerable to Lightning.

entries: When you dismiss the blade or lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on it, Exhaust the Invested die.

{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you can manifest an uninvested psiblade in a free hand, which remains manifested for the duration or until you dismiss it. It has the following special features:

items: Its damage die is a d6, it deals Thunder damage, and it has the {@itemMastery Nick} mastery property, which is unlocked for you.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls with this blade against creatures made of brittle inorganic material, such as glass, crystal, or stone, and against creatures with keen hearing.

psionic.name: Blade of Woe
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥⥥→⟱ (Invest 2 → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You manifest a blade of solidified misery which darkens the air around it with a miasma of despair. It functions like a weapon manifested with the psiblade feature, with the following alterations:

items: Both dice spent to manifest the blade become the blade's damage dice.
It deals Necrotic damage.

When you deal damage to a creature with this blade, that creature makes a Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, it gains a temporary level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. It loses all such levels when the blade is dismissed.

entries: When you dismiss the blade or lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on it, Exhaust one of the Invested dice and Divest the other.
{@i Heighten} — If you Invested at least one spirit shard, you add it to Constitution saving throws you make to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this talent.

psionic.name: Celerity
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You focus ambient numena into the soles of your feet, causing them to glow. For the duration, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.
For up to 10 feet of movement each turn, you can move on vertical surfaces as you would move on horizontal ones, while leaving your hands free.
✦ {@b Improvement}: The {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and the amount of special movement this talent grants increases when you reach APL 5 (15 feet), 11 (20 feet), and 17 (25 feet).

psionic.name: Crown of Awe
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You Invest a psi die into yourself to weave a piece of your psychic energy into a halo of peaceful light, which floats in orbit around your head. For the duration, you can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}.
The crown lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can attempt to beguile a creature that can see you within 20 feet of you. That creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the beginning of your next turn. On a success, it is immune to this talent for the next 10 minutes.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you can Further this talent as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, rather than an Action.

psionic.name: Crown of Loathing
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest a psi die into yourself to weave a piece of your psychic energy into a halo of hateful light, which floats in orbit around your head. It grants you the following benefits:

items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}.

Whenever you deal Psychic damage to a creature, if you roll 4 or higher on at least one of your damage dice, that creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or gain the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entries: The crown lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you add it to damage rolls you make against creatures with the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

psionic.name: Crown of Secrets
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest a psi die into yourself to weave a piece of your psychic energy into a halo of shadow, which floats in orbit around your head. It grants you the following benefits:

items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Deception|XPHB}.
Whenever you attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, if both results meet or exceed the target's AC, the attack deals {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} extra Psychic damage to that creature.

entries: The crown lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you also add your psionic ability modifier to the extra damage.

psionic.name: Eye of Navigation
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest a psi die into yourself to form a star-like eye which hovers before your forehead. It grants you the following benefits:
