items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Survival|XPHB}.

You know which way is north, which way is up, and where you have been since you manifested the Eye, all with perfect acuity. You can use this to retrace your steps or to point from your current location to a place you have been since manifestation.

entries: The eye lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.

entries.name: Furtherance: ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can map out a perfect, passable path to a location you or a willing creature you touch has visited before. You recall that path impeccably for one minute, but that memory fades after that minute passes. During that time, you can make a DC 15 {@skill Survival|XPHB} check to attempt to accurately record or relay the details of that path. On a success, you convey all the essentials of what you learned. On a failure, you convey only the correct direction. You fail automatically if you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} during your attempt. At the end of the minute, the eye closes, the Investment ends, and your Invested die is Exhausted.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you can attempt to locate an object you or the willing creature has touched before.

psionic.name: Eye of Prediction
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest a psi die into yourself to form a spiritual eye, which hovers before your forehead. It grants you the following benefits:

items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Perception|XPHB}.
You can't be {@status Surprised|XPHB}.
Whenever you deal damage, if it's not your turn, you deal {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} extra damage.

entries: The eye lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.

entries.name: Furtherance: ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can grant yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls you make before the beginning of your next turn. At that time, the eye closes, the Investment ends, and your Invested die is Exhausted.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, during the Furtherance, you can make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} without expending your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

psionic.name: Eye of Recollection
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest a psi die into yourself to form a tripartite eye, which hovers before your forehead. It grants you the following benefits:

items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill History|XPHB} or {@skill Religion|XPHB}.
Creatures that have hit you with attack rolls since you activated this talent have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

entries: The eye lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.

entries.name: Furtherance: ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can peer into the past of an unattended object within 5 feet of you. The eye flares with power, granting you a brief vision of a significant event that happened within 10 feet of that object. You make an Intelligence check with a DC determined by your DM. On a success, you receive a clear vision which provides you with information. On a failure, the vision is a confusing jumble which provides scraps of knowledge, but no complete picture. Either way, the eye closes, the Investment ends, and your Invested die is Exhausted.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, the Furtherance can target an attended object.

psionic.name: Eye of Revelation
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⇓ (Invest → Tap 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest a psi die into yourself to form a brilliant eye, which hovers before your forehead. It grants you the following benefits:

items: You can add the roll of the Invested die to any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make using {@skill Insight|XPHB} or {@skill Investigation|XPHB}.
Creatures that you can see have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on tests made to deceive you.

entries: The eye lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Tap it.

entries.name: Furtherance: ⟱ (Exhaust 1)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can briefly tap the eye's full potential. Until the end of this turn, you have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet. At the end of this turn, the eye closes, the Investment ends, and your Invested die is Exhausted.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, the Furtherance allows you to perceive invisible creatures and objects for one minute after the Investment ends.

psionic.name: Imager's Raiment
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} Invest 2 → Exhaust 1
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest two of your psi dice back into yourself to weave together an adaptive coating that protects and supports you, granting you the following benefits:

items: When you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Test} using a tool, you can roll one of the Invested dice to gain a bonus to that test equal to the result.
Whenever you take damage, if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries: {@i Heighten} — If either Invested die is a spirit shard, when this talent grants {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, increase the amount gained by your psionic ability modifier.
When this talent ends, Divest the Invested dice, then Exhaust one of them.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychoformation
entries: If you have the Psychoformation foundation, unlock the following effects.
Your psychoformation foundation improves in several ways:

items: You can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
The range at which you can create objects increases to 30 feet.
The number of objects you can have at once increases by one. You choose which one(s) cease(s) to exist when this talent ends.

psionic.name: Mantle of Authority
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You Invest a psi die into yourself to weave a piece of your psychic energy into a field of thrumming power which wraps itself around your shoulders. For the duration, you add the roll of the die to your Wisdom or Charisma saving throws.
The mantle lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Exhaust it.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns for the duration, you can inspire one ally within 60 feet. That creature can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to do one of the following:

items: Make one weapon attack.
Take a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}.
Move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries: {@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, the first time you inspire each creature with the Furtherance, it doesn't use its Reaction to act. That creature doesn't gain this benefit again until you activate a fresh instance of this talent.

psionic.name: Mantle of Glory
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You Invest a psi die into yourself to weave a piece of your psychic energy into a field of braided power that flows across your shoulders. It grants you the following benefits: You add the roll of the Invested die to your Strength and Constitution saving throws. When you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} or cause another creature to do so, increase the amount by {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]}.
The mantle lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Exhaust it.
{@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, whenever you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, double your current {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

psionic.name: Mantle of Mastery
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} ⥥→ ⟱ (Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You Invest a psi die into yourself to weave a piece of your psychic energy into a field of scintillating power that drips across your shoulders. You add the roll of the Invested die to your Dexterity and Intelligence saving throws.
The mantle lasts until you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. The die remains Invested for the duration. When your psi die is Divested, Exhaust it.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns for the duration, you can do one of the following:

items: Take the {@action Dash|XPHB} Action to move up to half your speed.
Take the {@action Study|XPHB} action.
Make an attack with a weapon with the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.

entries: {@i Heighten} — If the Invested die is a spirit shard, you can also take a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, so long as that action has at least one psi die as a cost and you pay that cost using a spirit shard.

psionic.name: Solace
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} —
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You focus ambient numena into your skin, causing it to glimmer and emit a pleasant aroma.

Allies in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {@variantrule Temporary Damage|QuetsPsionicVolI}. Effects that prevent those creatures from regaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} instead reduce the amount gained by half.
{@b Improvement} — The radius of your {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} increases when you reach APL 5 (10 feet), 11 (15 feet), and 17 (20 feet).

psionic.name: Striker's Raiment
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} Invest 2 → Exhaust 1
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest two of your psi dice back into yourself to weave together a raiment of flowing strands, granting you the following benefits:

items: Creatures further than 60 feet away from you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.
When a creature attacks you at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, it rolls three dice, rather than two. It still takes the lowest result.

entries: {@i Heighten} — If you spend one or more spirit shards to activate this talent, as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature misses you with an attack with which it had {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, you can deal that creature {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} Psychic damage.
When this talent ends, Divest the Invested dice, then Exhaust one of them.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychic Strike
entries: If you have the Psychic Strike foundation, unlock the following effects.

items: The range of Psychic Strike increases by 30 feet.
Once per turn when you hit with Psychic Strike, you can deal an extra {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} damage.

psionic.name: Whisper's Raiment
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 Action
{@b Range:} Self
{@b Target:} Self
{@b Cost:} Invest 2 → Exhaust 1
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
You Invest two of your psi dice back into yourself to weave together a raiment of ghostly, pulsing visages, which flow over your body, mouthing unknowable words. It grants you the following bonuses:

items: When you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Test} to inflict or resist the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you can roll one of the Invested dice to gain a bonus to the roll equal to the result.

As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature you can see deals damage to you, before you make the saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this talent, you can force that creature to make a Charisma saving throw. If it fails, it gains the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, and you maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} without making a saving throw.

entries: {@i Heighten} — On a failure, the creature also takes {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Psychic damage from each Invested spirit shard.
When this talent ends, Divest the Invested dice, then Exhaust one of them.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychophonics
entries: If you have the Psychophonics foundation, unlock the following effects.

items: The range of your psychophonics is doubled.
Your cryptogogy talents that deal damage deal an extra {@footnote [✧✧]|Any two different dice spent on this.} damage of the same type.

psionic.name: Collapse
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} 15 feet
{@b Target:} Object or Creature
{@b Cost:} ⟱⟱[✦⟱⟱] (Exhaust 4/✦2)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}

You focus your mind on a creature or object of your size or smaller that you can see within range, forcing it to violently collapse in on itself. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for the duration.

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On each failure, it takes Bludgeoning damage equal to the roll of the Exhausted dice. Then, if its current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point total} is lower than your psionic ability score × 2, it dies immediately as its body collapses inward.
After three successful saves, the talent ends.
✦ If your target succeeds on the initial saving throw, two of the activation dice remain unspent.
{@i Heighten} — Whenever your target succeeds on one of the repeated saves, you can Refresh one of the spirit shards spent to activate this talent.

psionic.name: Mind Spy
entries: {@b Activation Time:} 1 minute
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} Creature
{@b Cost:} ✦ ⥥→ ⟱(Invest → Exhaust 1)
{@b Duration:} ∞ {@status Concentration|XPHB|(C)}
One creature you can see within range must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or become Invested with the spent die for the duration.

While a creature is Invested by this talent, you use that creature's bodily senses in place of your own, including its vision, hearing, touch, and any special senses such as {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}. During that time, you can't use the senses of your own body. You gain the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} and {@condition Blinded|XPHB} conditions, and you treat that creature as the source of your Psychophonics.
✦ If your target succeeds, your die remains unspent, but your target learns of your attempt and of your exact location.
When this talent ends, Exhaust the Invested die.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you also perceive any telepathic communication the Invested creature emits or receives.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: As a {@action Psionic Action|QuetsPsionicVolI}, you can force a creature within range of your Psychophonics to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, transfer the Investment to that creature. On a success, this talent ends, and both creatures become aware of your attempt and location.

psionic.name: Muffle
entries: {@b Activation Time:} Action
{@b Range:} {@optfeature Psychophonics|QuetsPsionicVolI|PH}
{@b Target:} Creature
{@b Cost:} ⇓→⥥ (Tap → Invest 1)
{@b Duration:} 1 minute

One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you Invest it with the spent die, filling its senses with imperceptible humming. While Invested, that creature is considered {@condition Deafened|XPHB} to any sound that originates more than 30 feet away from it.
On a success, your target knows that you attempted to manipulate its senses.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when the creature makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check, you can roll the Invested die and subtract the result from the total, Divesting the die and ending the effect.
Heighten — If you spend a spirit shard, the die isn't Divested upon furthering this talent.

trait.name: Quick and Slick
entries: The tulpa's movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and it can use its {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} to move freely upon the bodies of creatures larger than it.

trait.name: Smaller Target
entries: While it is climbing on another creature, attacks against the tulpa have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and attacks that miss it hit the creature it is climbing upon instead.

action.name: Nibble
entries: {@atk m} PB + 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 + 3} Piercing damage.

ac.special: The construct has AC equal to your psionic save DC.

trait.name: Breaker Only: Weaken
entries: When the astral construct hits a creature with an attack, mark that creature until the beginning of your next turn. The next time a creature deals damage to the marked creature, the damaging creature deals an additional {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} damage. Then remove the mark.

trait.name: Guard Only: Fortified Construction
entries: When the astral construct is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

action.name: Astral Weapon
entries: {@atk m} PB + PM to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. one target.
{@note Breaker Only: Range 50/180 feet, one target}
{@note Harrier Only: Reach 10 feet, one target}
{@h}{@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + PM Force damage.

reaction.name: Guard Only: Block
entries: {@actTrigger} When a creature within 5 feet of the astral construct takes damage. {@actResponse} The construct reduce that damage by {@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + PM.

items.name: Astral Weapon
entries: {@atk m} PB + PM to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. one target. {@h}{@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + PM Force damage.

items.name: Astral Weapon
entries: {@atk m} PB + PM to hit, reach 50/180 ft., one target. one target. {@h}{@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + PM Force damage.

items.name: Astral Weapon
entries: {@atk m} PB + PM to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. one target. {@h}{@damage d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} + PM Force damage.

item.name: Lightpost
entries: A gleaming staff with a 6-foot haft appears in an unoccupied space within range, tipped by a glowing lantern. The lantern sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet, which can be any color like from among those you can perceive. It appears balanced perfectly on its tip, though it can easily be knocked over or grasped as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

The lightpost disappears early if you use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to dismiss it. ✦ If you Invest the lightpost, it persists until you dismiss it. An Invested lightpost is a psionic weapon with the following properties.

entries.name: {@i Heighten}
entries: If you spend a spirit shard, you have mastery with the lightpost.

item.name: Heavy Bow
entries: You Invest the spent die into the formation of a heavy bow of solidified numena, which appears in your hand. It is a psionic weapon with following properties. You have proficiency with it, but other creatures can't wield it.
After the bow forms, you can immediately make one attack with it using the die Invested to form it.
{@i Heighten} — If the bow is Invested with at least one spirit shard, you have mastery with it.

entries.name: Furtherance
entries: To make any future ranged attack with the bow, you must Invest an additional die, which becomes the damage die for that attack. ✦ Then, if the bow has a number of Invested equal to or greater than your psionic ability modifier, you must immediately make another attack with it as part of the same action. Dismiss the bow, Divest all dice Invested into it, Exhaust one, then roll them all. On a hit, this attack deals Force damage equal to the result + your psionic ability modifier. Hit or miss, it then explodes in a 15-foot Sphere centered on your target. Roll the dice again. Each creature in the sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the new result on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

{@i Heighten} — If you Exhaust a spirit shard for the bow's final attack, creatures that fail the Dexterity saving throw gain the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Chakram
entries: You construct a unique psionic weapon, a hollow discus with a razor-sharp edge, which appears in your open hand. It has the following properties.

For the duration, you have proficiency and mastery with the chakram, and you can use your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls. When thrown for an attack, it returns to your hand immediately after the attack hits or misses.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychokinesis
entries: If you have the Psychokinesis foundation, unlock the following effects.

Whenever you hit with the chakram when making a ranged attack, you can immediately make an attack against a new target you can see within 30 feet of the previous target, delaying the chakram's return. You can't make this bonus attack against a target you've already attacked with the chakram this turn, and you don't add your ability modifier to the damage of any bonus attacks you make. You also don't add it to the attack rolls of any bonus attacks you make beyond the second.
{@i Heighten} — You add your ability modifier to the damage of the first two bonus attacks you make with the chakram each turn.

item.name: Passkey
entries: You craft a Tiny morphic key which — in theory — can be used to unlock anything. You can use it as though it were Thieves' Tools when attempting to pick a lock. When you do, you can use your psionic ability modifier for the ability check, but you don't add your proficiency bonus unless you have proficiency with Thieves' Tools.
✦ If you Invest the key, it persists until you dismiss it. An Invested key is a psionic weapon with the following properties. You have proficiency with it.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you have mastery with the key.

item.name: Tiger's Fang
entries: You construct a unique psionic weapon, a piercing, fanglike stiletto set into a simple hilt, which appears in your open hand. It has the following properties.
For the duration, you have proficiency and mastery with the stiletto, and you can use your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the stiletto deals an additional [✧] Thunder damage on a hit.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychotelechy
entries: If you have the Psychotelechy foundation, unlock the following effects.
You can shape a second stiletto, which appears in another open hand. Both weapons count as psiblades for features that modify the function of psiblades.

item.name: Titan's Gauntlet
entries: You construct a unique psionic weapon, a piercing, fanglike stiletto set into a simple hilt, which appears in your open hand. It has the following properties.
For the duration, you have proficiency and mastery with the stiletto, and you can use your psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, the stiletto deals an additional {@dice d4;d6;d8;d10;d12|[✧]} Thunder damage on a hit.

entries.name: Synergy: Psychotelechy
entries: If you have the Psychotelechy foundation, unlock the following effects.
You can shape a second stiletto, which appears in another open hand. Both weapons count as psiblades for features that modify the function of psiblades.

item.name: Titan's Knife
entries: You construct a unique psionic weapon, an oversized sword of solidified numena, which appears in the open hand of you or a creature within range. It has the following properties.
When he Invested die Divests, Exhaust it.

When making a weapon attack, rather than a single target, a creature attacking with the knife can select up to three targets within its reach, chosen in sequence, though it uses the same attack roll for each target. Each target must be within 5 feet of the previous target.
{@i Heighten} — If you spend a spirit shard, you and allies wielding this weapon have mastery with it.

itemMastery.name: Knock
entries: As an {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make a special attack directed at a creature's head. On a hit, your target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take an additional {@damage 1d4} damage. It can't benefit from {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.name: Intent
entries: When making an attack with an Intent weapon, you can use your spellcasting or psionic ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls. (You must use the same modifier for both rolls.)

condition.name: Irradiated
entries: While it has the Irradiated condition, a creature experiences the following effects.

entries.name: Radiation Levels
entries: This condition is cumulative. Each time a creature receives it, it gains 1 Radiation level. A creature can have up to 5 levels of Radiation

entries.name: Damage
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns and once per turn when it takes Radiant damage, an Irradiated creature and all creatures touching it each take {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage per level of Radiation.

condition.name: Malleable
entries: A creature with this condition has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Lightning and Necrotic damage. If it would regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it instead regains twice as many.

condition.name: Brittle
entries: A creature vhth Brittle X takes an additional X damage whenever it takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or Force damage. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}. A creature can have this condition any number of times.

action.name: Psionic Action
entries: When you take the Psionic action, you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action or use a feature or psionic item that requires a Psionic action to be activated.

If you activate a talent that has an activation time of 1 minute or longer, you must take the Psionic action on each turn of that activation, and you must maintain Concentration while you do so. If your Concentration is broken, the talent fails, but you don't expend a resource.

variantrule.name: Critical Hit Range
entries: Normally, an attack roll scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 20 on the d20. Expanding the range by 1 means that your attack will score a critical hit on a roll of either 19 or 20. Expanding it by 2, or using two features that expand it by 1 each, means that your attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.
Reducing the Critical Hit Range for an attack that hasn't had its Critical Hit Range expanded means that the attack can't score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}.
The Critical Hit Range for an attack can't be expanded by more than 4 (to a range of 15-20).

variantrule.name: Brilliant Light
entries: Creatures in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} have Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures in {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

variantrule.name: Temporary Damage
entries: Some effects deal Temporary Damage or convert damage into Temporary Damage. Temporary Damage doesn't cause a creature or an object to lose {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

Taking Damage. When a creature with any Temporary Damage takes damage, all of its Temporary Damage becomes true damage first, resulting in a loss of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Since {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}, {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}, and other forms of damage mitigation applied to the Temporary Damage, they don't apply again when it becomes true damage.

entries.name: Subdual
entries: Temporary Damage also becomes true damage if it exceeds a creature's current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Alleviating Temporary Damage
entries: Regaining any number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} first removes — sometimes called "alleviates" — all Temporary Damage.

entries.name: With {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}
entries: Temporary Damage and Temporary Damage remove one another: Taking Temporary Damage causes you to lose that many {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and gaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} alleviates that much Temporary Damage. For example, if a creature with 10 Temporary Damage would gain 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, it loses 5 Temporary Damage instead. Similarly, a creature with 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} that takes 5 Temporary Damage instead loses 5 THP.

entries.name: They Stack
entries: Keep track of your Temporary Damage, because unlike {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, it is cumulative.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Temporary Damage lasts until it is removed or until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, unless the effect that applied it says otherwise.

entries.name: Spirit Cultivation
entries: You gain a number of bonus Rank 1 ({@dice d4}) spirit shards equal to the modifier of the ability score increased by this feat.

entries.name: Enduring Shards
entries: When you roll a 4 on a spirit shard while Tapping it, it remains unspent. If you do so while Exhausting it, Tap it instead.

feat.name: Broadened Potential
entries: The possibilities of the mind expand before you. You gain one {@filter psionic foundation|optionalfeatures|source=quetspsionicvoli|feature type=psionic foundations} that you don't already possess. You must choose a new foundation each time you take this feat.

entries.name: Grasping Tip
entries: While holding a psiblade, you can make and maintain grapples with that psiblade as though it were a hand making an {@action Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. When you do, the psiblade doesn't deal damage, but you can use Dexterity, rather than Strength, to determine your grapple's save DC.

entries.name: Energy Burn
entries: In place of one attack when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can deal Psychic damage to a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by your psiblade equal to the roll of its damage die.

entries.name: Overseer
entries: Your ranged psionic attacks ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover and Three Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Overbear
entries: Hostile creatures that take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} from you. Rather than make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to target the triggering creature with your psychic strike.

entries.name: Psi
entries: Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. You gain a number of bonus rank 1 ({@dice d4}) psi dice equal to half your modifier for the chosen ability score, rounded up, and that score is your psionic ability for this feat's talents.

items.name: ➔ Improvement
entries: Those psi dice become rank 2 ({@dice d6}) once your character level is 5+.

entries.name: Two Talents
entries: You learn two {@filter psionic talents|psionics|source=quetspsionicvoli} of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites, one of which must be a {@filter free talent|psionics|source=quetspsionicvoli|type=t}.

entries.name: Uncarnate
entries: At the beginning of your turn, if you are concentrating on a Zenithurgy talent, you can overtake your body and temporarily ascend into a spiritual form. While in that form, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all nonpsionic damage, and you can't gain the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions. You exit this form automatically at the beginning of your next turn and if you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Once you've used this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

prerequisite.other: The ability to activate at least one talent

entries.name: Concentration
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entries.name: Punishing Psionics
entries: When a creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} from you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to activate a talent targeting that creature, rather than making an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}. That talent must have an activation time of one action and must target only that creature.

entries.name: Constant Motion
entries: When you activate a talent, you can move up to 5 feet. That movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.
